articleTitle: An End-to-End Pipeline Integrating Segmentation, Anomaly Detection, and Report Generation for Medical Imaging Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Medical imaging plays a pivotal role in diagnosing and treating a variety of conditions, from brain abnormalities to retinal diseases. However, interpreting large volumes of imaging data remains an arduous and time-consuming task for radiologists, necessitating the development of automated diagnostic tools. In this paper, we present an integrated end-to-end pipeline that leverages state-of-the-art techniques in segmentation, anomaly detection, and medical report generation to improve both accuracy and efficiency. At the core of our approach lies a modified Visual Large Language Model (VLM), adapted with medical-specific adapters to transition from natural image analysis to medical image diagnostics. Our system, tested in few-shot (k=4) learning settings, demonstrates superior performance with over 90% Area Under the Curve (AUC) for anomaly detection and segmentation across diverse domains such as Brain MRI, Chest X-ray, and Retina scans. Post-anomaly detection, a custom labeling model performs multiclass classification of anomaly regions, assigning severity scores to detected abnormalities. A fine-tuned Open source Large Language Model (LLM) then generates comprehensive diagnostic reports that not only summarize findings but also suggest further diagnostic pathways. Compared to state-of-the-art models such as AprilGAN, our system demonstrates notable improvements in accuracy, adaptability, and clinical utility. These contributions establish our pipeline as a promising tool for enhancing medical imaging workflows.

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Indian Print Media Organisations: Journalists' Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: With Artificial Intelligence (AI) and generative AI potentially changing the landscape of journalism, this research paper investigates the perspective of Indian print media journalists concerning the adoption of AI at the individual and organisational levels. Authors deploy exploratory factor analysis to retrieve factors concerning AI from the loaded statements. The exploratory factor analysis identified training, awareness, usage, and integration as key factors concerning journalists' use of AI. The conceptual model developed for the study, tested using principal component regression, reveals that journalists' awareness, usage, training and integration of AI impact journalistic practice. This study is one of the first studies on AI and journalism in the Indian context. Further, it bridges the gap between the available literature on the said topic and provides valuable insights into the broader implications of AI in media and communication.

articleTitle: The Impact of Strategic Asset Allocation in Mutual Funds on Investor Profitability
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Asset allocation in mutual funds is a strategic approach to diversifying investment portfolios by distributing funds across various asset classes such as equity, debt, stocks, and gold. The primary goal of asset allocation is to optimize portfolio performance under different market conditions, balancing risk and return. During the COVID-19 pandemic, equity mutual funds' asset allocation decisions were significantly influenced by market uncertainty. Funds prefer firms with lower risk profiles, higher financial flexibility, and larger asset sizes during the early stages of the pandemic, indicating a shift towards safer assets amidst heightened uncertainty. This trend reversed later, suggesting a dynamic response to evolving market conditions. Overall, asset allocation in mutual funds is a critical component of investment strategy, particularly during periods of market volatility. It requires a careful assessment of risk tolerance, investment goals, and market conditions to ensure a wellperforming and resilient portfolio. The pandemic has underscored the importance of agility and adaptability in asset allocation strategies, as funds navigate through unprecedented challenges and opportunities.

articleTitle: Chest X-Ray Analysis Using Machine Learning for Pneumonia Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: A dangerous and potentially fatal respiratory infection is pneumonia., especially for young children and the elderly. With the shortage of radiologists, our automated approach can help fill the gap by providing a quick and reliable diagnosis. By leveraging advanced machine learning techniques, with the ultimate goal of improving patient outcomes by increasing the effectiveness and accuracy of pneumonia detection. Our study proposes an automated approach to detect pneumonia by applying advanced machine learning strategies to chest radiographs. The method is taking relevant information out of the photos and using a robust classification algorithm to distinguish between healthy images and images that show pneumonia. For image processing tasks, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm is selected due to its efficacy. A useful indicator for assessing pneumonia detection systems, the F1 score aids in determining how well machine learning models work. By indicating the model's capacity to precisely detect optimistic cases while reducing false positives, it offers a reasonable valuation of overall performance. The created model is a useful tool to assist healthcare workers in promptly identifying cases of pneumonia, since it demonstrates promising sensitivity and specificity. The findings of this study have implications for respiratory infection treatment that include accelerating diagnosis times, decreasing human error, and eventually increasing patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Brushless DC Motor with Integrated Speed Control
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Due to the excellent speed control, small size and great efficiency, brushless DC (BLDC) motors are becoming more and more popular. These characteristics make them perfect for high-performance systems like drones and electric cars. In this work, the design of BLDC motors is thoroughly analyzed and the motor's functionality is optimally simulated using a Simulink model across a range of operating situations. The study examines the fundamental design ideas of brushless DC motors, which have several advantages over conventional motors, such as a high torque-to-weight ratio and less electromagnetic interference. A thorough comparison is offered, emphasizing the improved performance of the BLDC motor in sensitive electrical environments and space-constrained settings. The article also addresses the possibilities of BLDC motors in the future, namely in propelling the electric revolution in a variety of industries, including the transportation sector, which includes electric, hybrid and airborne vehicles. This study intends to provide important insights that help direct future breakthroughs and applications in advanced motor technologies by offering a thorough analysis of the theoretical and practical elements of BLDC motor design and operation.

articleTitle: Real-Time ID Card Detection Using Different YOLO Models
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: A secure environment within educational institutions is a critical concern, especially given the diverse demographic that includes students, faculty, and staff. The capability to accurately identify individuals through identity cards is integral to ensuring safety, particularly during high-traffic periods such as admissions and large-scale events. This paper offers a comprehensive analysis of the YOLO V7, V8, and V9 models for real-time identity card detection, Utilizing cutting-edge deep learning techniques. The dataset used is 1037 images from Roboflow Universe, “dress-code-detection-myycl”, which includes images of people without and with ID cards, as well as with changes in clothes that can be classified by gender. The working methodology followed will involve dataset annotation, training three models of YOLO with given configurations of input size, epochs, loss functions, and image augmentation, and testing their performances based on precision, recall, mAP50, and mAP50:95. The results indicate that YOLOv8 achieved the highest mAP50:95 of 72.63%, outperforming YOLOv9 (70.69%) and YOLOv7 (38.42%). This suggests that YOLOv8 demonstrates superior accuracy in real-time ID card detection.The research evaluates the performance of each model in terms of accuracy, processing speed, and robustness, providing a detailed evaluation of their practical applications in a campus security context. By enhancing identification processes, these models aim to bolster security protocols, mitigate potential threats, and streamline daily operations. This study not only emphasizes the pivotal role of deep learning in educational security but also provides actionable insights into the optimal model for effective identity card detection, contributing to the advancement of safe and efficient educational environments.

articleTitle: Automated Lung Segmentation Using Deep Leaning in Lung CT Images
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Lung segmentation algorithms are crucial for accurately delineating the areas of infection within the lungs. The main aim of this research work is to generate a highly efficient and reliable deep learning model for lung segmentation. This will be achieved by utilizing chest computed tomography (CT) images and DeepLabV3+ networks. The model will be designed to classify the images into two classes (background and lung field). This work examines the efficacy of the DeepLab V3+network using three pre-trained networks: Xception, ResNet-18, Inception-ResNet-50, MobileNet-v2. The evaluation of the segmentation performance has been conducted using five performance metrics: Intersection of Union (IoU), Weighted IoU, Balance Fl score, pixel accuracy, and global accuracy. The empirical findings of this study validate that the DeepLabv3+ network, when coupled with ResNet-18 and a batch size of 8, exhibits superior performance in two-class segmentation. In the proposed work the mean accuracy and Mean IoU is 99.59% and 98.89% respectively. The automated segmentation model we have built can be enhanced to serve as a clinical diagnosis method for lung diseases.

articleTitle: Voice Controlled Autonomous Vehicle: Execution on a Small Scale
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of improving user interaction with autonomous vehicles by integrating voice command recognition with real-time visual feedback. The study employs Google's speech recognition Application Programming Interface to transcribe spoken commands and the turtle graphics library to simulate the corresponding vehicle actions. The system is designed to accurately recognize and process voice commands, translating them into visual simulations that mirror the intended vehicle movements. The research method involved testing the system with various commands to assess its performance and effectiveness. The findings suggest that this integrated approach has significant potential for enhancing the usability and accessibility of autonomous vehicle systems.

articleTitle: Technical Analysis and Comparison of Intrusion Detection Systems Using Hybrid Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) are critical components in securing network environments against a myriad of cyber threats. The evolution of machine learning (ML) techniques has significantly enhanced the capabilities of IDS, offering improved detection accuracy, adaptability, and real-time analysis. This research covers a variety of machine learning approaches, such as supervised and hybrid strategies. We assess these models' performance using important measures including computational efficiency, precision, recall etc. The results show that although supervised machine learning models provides high accuracy, but when used in hybrid model including Random Forests and SVM improves performance. The result is a hybrid model that leverages the strengths of each approach. For instance, Random Forest can provide a robust feature representation, while SVM can refine the decision boundary, leading to a more accurate and reliable classification model. This combination often yields better performance than using any single algorithm alone. This paper underscores the importance of selecting appropriate ML techniques tailored to specific network environments and threat landscapes.

articleTitle: Implementation of Multi-Format EXIF Metadata Extraction from Images
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The extraction of EXIF (Exchangeable Image File Format) metadata, which provides information about the aspects of data in digital camera images, is essential in various applications such as geolocation, privacy protection protocols, and cyber analysis. This project presents a novel approach using Python with the ‘piexif’ and ‘pyheif’ libraries, which support the extraction of metadata from diverse image formats such as JPG, JPEG, and HEIC. Using these libraries, to effortlessly retrieve date, time, and GPS coordinates, and finally link these geo-coordinates to Maps in a speedy and flexible manner working across any platforms and environments. Our project demonstrates a lightweight, efficient solution without the overhead of too many modules.

articleTitle: Development of Multipurpose Smart Desk Assistant for a Department
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The project is going to be focused on the enhancement of the internal organizational communication within an academic department by developing an effective information display system supported with the Internet of Things (IoT). For the rendering, the system employs a Raspberry Pi; the front end is built with ReactJS while the back end is coded with Python Flask; data storage is done on MongoDB Cloud. It can display real time event posters, notices, timetable, the current time and even the current temperature of the place to make all feel updated and synchronized. The goal of this project is to demonstrate how IoT and human-center design can help make department communication more effective and enjoyable and because this proposal is designed for implementation at Georgia State, it could be used as a framework for the implementation of similar systems in other educational settings.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Healthcare Outcome Improvement: A Decentralized Method of Patient Care
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Blockchain technology offers transformative potential in healthcare management by enhancing the security, privacy, and interoperability of patient data. This paper presents a comprehensive review of current blockchain applications in healthcare and proposes a blockchain-based healthcare management system that facilitates secure, decentralized medical data exchange. The system ensures finegrained control over data access while maintaining integrity and transparency through immutable records. Our analysis examines various blockchain platforms, smart contracts, and challenges faced in integrating this technology into healthcare. By leveraging blockchain, we aim to address data siloing, legacy system issues, and administrative inefficiencies, ultimately improving patient outcomes and system efficiency. Blockchain technology has emerged as a transformative solution in the healthcare sector, offering robust mechanisms to address the longstanding challenges of data security, interoperability, and privacy. In healthcare, managing sensitive patient data securely while ensuring real-time access across various entities has been a persistent issue. This paper presents a comprehensive review of blockchain's application in healthcare management systems and proposes a blockchain-based system model that offers decentralized data storage, enhanced data privacy, and improved control over Electronic Health Records (EHR). The proposed system integrates smart contracts, enabling seamless and secure sharing of medical records between healthcare providers and patients while ensuring compliance with regulatory frameworks such as HIPAA and GDPR. By leveraging blockchain's immutable and transparent properties, the system addresses issues such as data tampering, unauthorized access, and data siloing. This study also examines existing literature, highlighting the potential and limitations of blockchain technology in healthcare. Our findings demonstrate that while blockchain adoption in healthcare is still in its early stages, its potential to revolutionize healthcare data management is immense. The implementation of this system can lead to significant improvements in patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and cost reduction, contributing to the evolution of healthcare services in the digital age.

articleTitle: Disrupting Agri-Supply Chains: The Role of Blockchain in Quality Control and Traceability
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Blockchain technology has enormous potential to enhance the quality monitoring of agricultural supply chains. As such, this paper explores how blockchain is poised to overcome critical agri-supply chain issues like inefficiencies and lack of traceability, common with old systems. Utilizing blockchain—a distributed and immutable ledger that records every transaction and movement throughout the supply chain, ensuring transparency and security of data. This provides a clear and traceable record of produce from the farm to the dinner table of the customer. Core attributes, such as smart contracts, enable the automation of quality assurance processes, thus ensuring adherence to regulations while minimizing manual scrutiny. Blockchain also allows consumers to have access to detailed information of the origin, quality, and journey of agricultural products, thus instilling trust and confidence. The text also shares examples of how blockchain can be practically applied in agri-supply chains to enhance efficiency and trust between stakeholders. The future of blockchain in agriculture, including possible solutions, challenges and limits of its implementation, is also explored in this paper. Highlighting how it can facilitate transparency, execution of quality assurances and improvement of stakeholder relationships, this paper illustrates blockchain's game-changing capability to improve the factuality and efficiency of agricultural systems.

articleTitle: Dark Patterns Detection and Classification Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: UX design shapes the interaction with a digital platform. Most practices., while attempting to increase user satisfaction., can actually deceive users using so-called dark patterns in order to gain an advantage for the service provider. This paper addresses the automated classification of five dark patterns: Urgency., Obstruction., Social Proof., Misdirection., and Scarcity., along with ethical UX practices., all labeled in English. First., different machine learning algorithms will be applied., such as Logistic Regression., Support Vector Machines., and Random Forest and Gaussian Naive Bayes with Grid-search for hyper parameter tuning. Then., the discussion of accuracy., confusion matrices., and AUC-ROC scores will present how such models can work toward the detection of dark patterns in order to foster ethical design.

articleTitle: Utilizing Sentiment Analysis and Machine Learning to Forecast Stock Price Changes from Financial News
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study looks into the use of sentiment analysis to forecast stock prices by using headlines from the day's financial news to foretell changes in the market. The research creates a prediction model that can anticipate whether stock prices will rise or fall based on sentiment gleaned from news stories by combining Natural Language Processing (NLP) with machine learning. CountVectorizer is used for preprocessing, tokenization, and feature extraction on a dataset of daily headlines and stock results (positive or negative). Using a Random Forest Classifier, high precision and recall metrics were attained along with an accuracy of 85.97%. The model performs well in forecasting rises in stock price, indicating the influence of market mood on stock behavior. In order to conduct a more thorough contextual analysis, future work will involve extending the model to include historical stock data, macroeconomic variables, and sophisticated NLP approaches like BERT. The present study underscores the capacity of sentiment analysis to augment financial market forecasting and decision-making.

articleTitle: Human Speech Based Emotion and Gender Recognition Using Hybrid SVM and Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study uses the RAVDESS Dataset to develop a hybrid model for predicting gender and emotion from human voice. To improve emotion categorization accuracy, the suggested system uses a two-stage methodology. Our goal is to predict the emotion as well as gender with higher accuracy in two different stages as mentioned below. A SVM model is used in the initial step of gender prediction to determine if the speaker is male or female. In the second step, a convolutional neural network (CNN) included with a recurrent neural network (RNN) model is used to forecast the speaker's mood, and the output of the SVM model is then integrated as an extra feature. The CNN-RNN model in this process is trained with Mel spectrograms and MFCC characteristics, and studies demonstrate how well this two-step approach works to enhance emotion identification capabilities. The method identifies eight different emotions. This two-way approach helps to identify the gender and the emotion of the voice with a better accuracy

articleTitle: Enhancing Dynamic Facial Authentication Through HCI
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: One kind of biometric technology that uses a person's facial features to check identification and manage access is a facial authentication system. This method uses complex algorithms to analyses and compare several face traits, including skin texture, feature arrangement, and sometimes even expressions, to authenticate an individual. Biometric authentication techniques, such as facial recognition, are vital to safeguard access to private devices and confidential data in an increasingly digital world. However, issues with user acceptability and security flaws frequently plague current systems. To overcome these obstacles, this study suggests a dynamic facial authentication method that combines improved security features with user-friendly interface design. The first part of the study examines the drawbacks of traditional static facial recognition systems, which are susceptible to spoofing assaults that use images or videos. By necessitating live interactions during the authentication process, the suggested dynamic solution enhances security by leveraging face motions and expressions to build a multifactor authentication process. The study also explores the dynamic facial authentication system's design elements, with an emphasis on user interface design, user experience, and the integration of machine learning algorithms for precise facial expression recognition. The outcomes demonstrate the system's capacity to prevent spoofing attempts while preserving an intuitive user interface. By presenting a revolutionary method that blends dynamic facial expressions with conventional facial recognition, the design of an intuitive and effective dynamic facial authentication system advances biometric authentication. This method ensures user acceptance and usability in a variety of applications, from secure access control systems to personal gadgets, and has the potential to greatly improve the security of authentication processes.

articleTitle: Mind Waves and Machines: Predicting Technologial Addiction with Electroencephalography
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study investigates the predictability of technological addiction using Electroencephalography data and machine learning models. Electroencephalography recordings from 1,000 participants were classified into three groups: addicted, not addicted, and recovered from addiction through meditation. A range of predictive modeling techniques, including Random Forest, XGBoost, and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), were used to classify addiction stages.. K-Nearest Neighbor achieved the highest accuracy of 95.62%, demonstrating that Electroencephalography signals can differentiate between addiction and recovery states, supporting the role of meditation in recovery.

articleTitle: Sustainability in Action: Analyzing the Triple-Bottom-Line in Indian MSME Businesses
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The present study delves into the sustainability practices of micro, small, and medium-scale enterprises (MSMEs) in India with a particular focus on the triple-bottom-line concept-profit, people, and planet. Amidst the growing significance of sustainability, this study assesses the consciousness, actions, and impacts of MSMEs. MSMEs play a very significant role in achieving balanced economic growth, social well-being, and environmental preservation. The performance of a diverse set of 208 industries is evaluated on ecological, economic, and social parameters. The findings suggest that MSMEs emphasize wealth creation while showcasing strides in energy conservation, waste recycling, and financial stability, and areas for improvement are identified accordingly. The research study contributes to the understanding of MSMEs' sustainability landscape, providing direction for future research to explore nuanced dimensions and enhance their role in holistic, sustainable development.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Compressive Strength Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Prediction of compressive strength in concrete is very important to ensure the safety and durability of any structure. In this paper, we introduce a machine-learning hybrid approach whereby we combine the strengths of two different models: CatBoost, working extremely well with structured data, and a neural network to grasp the underlying complex patterns within the data. Next, these models are combined, and their prediction is fine-tuned by another layer of linear regression to increase overall accuracy. The hybrid model achieved an RMSE of 3.86 and an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 0.94, demonstrating its superior accuracy compared to the individual models. Herein, the proposed method has been applied to the standard concrete strength data set, and the results of hybrid performance give more reliable predictions than either model alone. It is a promising technique that can find its practical applications in construction, providing insight into concrete strength and enabling engineers to make better decisions.

articleTitle: The New Paradigm in Education: Visionary Nexus
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Visionary Nexus is a novel platform designed to bridge the gap between academia and industry, providing students with direct access to industry-leading professionals for mentorship, teaching, and workshops. This paper presents the conceptual framework, design architecture, features, and future scope of Visionary Nexus, highlighting its unique approach to enhancing educational quality. By linking experts with educational institutions worldwide, Visionary Nexus ensures that students are exposed to the latest industry knowledge, preparing them for modern workforce challenges. The platform leverages a feedback-driven rating system, ensuring continuous improvement in teaching standards and expert performance. Additionally, its global outreach promotes diversity and inclusivity in education, equipping students with a broad perspective. As the platform evolves, future integration of AI for expert matching and expansion into emerging disciplines will further revolutionize access to industry expertise. Visionary Nexus is a transformative initiative redefining education, fostering collaboration, and shaping the future of global academic and professional development.

articleTitle: A Robust Early Diagnosis Heart Disease Prediction System Using Enhanced Deep Belief Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: In recent years, cardiovascular disease (CVD) has become the leading cause of death worldwide, posing a significant public health challenge. There are a multitude of specific cardiovascular disorders discussed. Multiple variables can increase an individual's susceptibility to heart disease, thus necessitating the need for precise and expeditious methods to identify and treat the ailment. This research suggests a heart disease prediction system that utilizes the enhanced deep belief network (DBN), a DL technology renowned for its ability to automatically extract hierarchical characteristics from intricate data. In the preprocessing stage, PCA is used to decrease the number of dimensions in the dataset and generate principle components that effectively represent the majority of the variation. The aim of this approach is to accurately assess the likelihood of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in patients by analyzing various medical parameters, including age, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels. The model is trained on the well-known Cleveland heart disease dataset and assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC-ROC. Due to its ability to recognize complex data patterns, the DBN can detect heart disease (HD) early. This system achieves achieves 98.73% of accuracy, 96.98% of precision, 97.42% of recall, 98.19% of specificity, 98.69% of sensitivity.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Investigation of Fully Networked Neural Networks for Determining the Remaining Useful Life of Lithium Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study aims to assess the performance of Fully Connected Networks, a kind of neural network model designed to predict batteries Remaining Useful Life. Each framework highlights that the model accuracy may be gradually improved by adding complexity or by applying different techniques like cross validation, regularization, dropout, early stopping and model ensemble. The Kaggle dataset provided the study dataset on lithium ion batteries. A dataset of about 1500 records were used in the analysis. Using the Colab platform, algorithms with various features were tested, and the outcomes were examined. After testing fully connected networks with various layers, regularization, dropout, early stopping, and numerous models, an ensemble technique demonstrated the best accuracy and lowest error values among fully connected networks with multiple models. The fully connected neural network using the ensemble approach performs comparably to the best single model in the comparison of fully connected neural networks under test cases algorithms for RUL prediction, although it may be more stable and less sensitive to data noise. The forecasts become more dependable when there is a small boost in performance and stability as a result of model averaging.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Recruitment with Large Language Models: A Multimodal AI Framework Integrating Video, Social Media, and Traditional Screening for Efficient Talent Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The classic problem with recruitment is the need to analyze multiple resumes in a short period while ensuring the best quality of hires. In the wake of Covid and the advent of generative AI, we have seen a modern approach to recruitment, digitizing the process to gather more suitable candidates for the institution. The process of recruiting candidates, especially for those in technical roles has lately gained a high rise. There has been a very rapid change to bring about non-contact based recruitment, helping institutions survey a wider range of people without limiting to geographical constraints. Newer recent changes seen since covid is the usage of online video chat platforms to conduct live one-on-one interviews. Our paper takes this approach of using video as a form of recruitment for screening candidates, we also delve into utilizing social recruitment also as a form of pre-screening using LinkedIn and GIT for technical roles. This paper also helps view pre-screening from traditional resumes and newer introduced methods by leveraging LLMs to help reduce human intervention until the final interviews. This approach helps combine the various diverse components into providing a solution to these recruitment challenges. The paper aims to help recruiters in selecting candidates more competently while improving time management, precision, objectivity, as well as reliability during the hiring processes.

articleTitle: Video Frame Prediction Using Convolutional LSTM Encoder and Decoder
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: With rapid growth of audiovisual content now spreading through social networking sites, chances of exposure towards violent and mature content by the youth are growing. This project addresses the risk of detection of such content using advanced video frame prediction techniques. We present here an encoder-decoder model of Convolutional LSTMs in the film for violent and obscene sequence detection. The spatiotemporal nature of video data encourages our algorithm to exploit accurate predictions of future frames from past content, which can be used in real time for dangerous material detection. The study relies on recent literature that highlights the psychological implications arising from the viewing of violent content by teenagers, thus making the need for efficient automated detection mechanisms ever more pertinent. Furthermore, we present a complete definition of “violence” for the standardized detection mechanisms and to cross-compare various studies. Using Violent Scene Detection, our results indicate high improvements in the detection accuracy and therefore become effective in this context for parental control and content moderation. Such results help safeguard children in the increasingly digital environment: traditional as well as currently ever-increasing.

articleTitle: NewsEye: AI Powered Anomaly Detection and News Reporting
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Traditional methods of anomaly detection frequently struggle with real-time monitoring, resulting in delayed detection of odd events. To address these limitations, we propose an integrated system that pre-processes surveillance video with resolution correction and noise reduction, followed by feature extraction using pre-trained CNN models like ResNet. Density-based methods, such as the Local Outlier Factor (LOF), are used to identify anomalies, which are then analysed using AUC-ROC criteria. GPT and other Natural Language Processing (NLP) models will also use to automate the generation of extensive news stories. The NewsEye project takes a fresh way to addressing the issues provided by the massive amounts of data produced by modern surveillance technologies. The proposed system intends to improve surveillance efficiency by delivering real-time anomaly detection and automatic news reporting, decreasing the need for human intervention.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Robotics in Automated Construction: Enhancing Efficiency, Precision, Safety, and Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The construction industry has begun to embrace artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics to address ongoing challenges such as inefficiencies, high labor costs, safety concerns, and the need for sustainable practices. This research focuses on exploring the potential of AI-driven robotics in the construction industry to enhance efficiency, productivity, safety, and sustain ability in construction through a comprehensive analysis of existing literature. The study identifies key applications of AI and robotics in automating repetitive tasks, such as 3D printing and prefabrication, which reduce material waste and improve design flexibility. The research also highlights AI's ability to improve on-site safety through real-time hazard detection and monitoring. However, the adoption of these technologies is hindered by barriers such as high costs, technical expertise requirements, and a lack of trust in AI systems. The study provides suggestions for overcoming these barriers, including investing in workforce training and promoting transparency in AI decision-making processes. The findings indicate that AI and robotics are essential for achieving sustainable construction practices, particularly by optimizing material use and reducing the energy footprint of construction projects. Although theoretical, this research provides a foundation for future empirical studies aimed at validating the practical applications of these technologies in real-world construction settings.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Humanoid Robot for Elderly Support System
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: To improve the quality of life for elderly people, an innovative solution is required. We have introduced a humanoid robot in this paper. This robot has advanced features like autonomous movement, generative AI for interactive communication, and facial recognition capabilities. And also, this humanoid robot proves to be cost-effective. The primary processing unit used here is a Raspberry Pi module. It runs the Robot Operating System 2 (ROS2) framework, which is managed via Docker, thus ensuring scalability and support for multi-robot coordination. The robot is designed with eight MG995 servo motors for joint movement and one SG90 servo motor for head movement, all powered by a rechargeable battery. The study's findings demonstrate successful user interactions and reliable mobility, underscoring the robot's potential to enhance care-giving tasks. The robot is unique in that it has a holistic design that combines cutting-edge technologies with user-centric features, to create a humanoid robot that is not only efficient and responsive but also emotionally intelligent and adaptable to the changing requirements of the elderly. Key benefits include improved health monitoring, companionship, and assistance with daily activities, establishing the robot as a valuable asset in healthcare. Potential applications include home care, rehabilitation, and therapy settings, addressing both the caregiver labour shortage and the increasing demand for elderly support systems.

articleTitle: Hybrid CNN-CatBoost Approach for Predicting Biodegradability of Synthetic Chemicals
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The field of environmental chemistry is essential for understanding the impacts of synthetic chemicals on ecosystems. The increasing prevalence of these substances poses significant challenges to ecosystem health, particularly regarding their biodegradability. Non-biodegradable materials threaten wildlife and human health, emphasizing the need for effective predictive methods. Traditional laboratory assessments of biodegradability are often laborintensive and costly, making it difficult to efficiently evaluate large numbers of compounds. To address these challenges, Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) models have been developed to establish correlations between chemical structures and biodegradability [1]. Nevertheless, it is challenging to characterize complicated interactions using conventional QSAR techniques that are present in numerous chemical databases [4]. The proposed model integrates Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with CatBoost, an advanced gradient boosting technique. This hybrid method effectively handles categorical variables and reduces overfitting while employing CNN to extract relevant features from molecular descriptors and improve predictive accuracy [2]. By implementing the CNN-CatBoost hybrid methodology, biodegradability predictions are significantly improved, facilitating better environmental management and helping to mitigate the challenges posed by chemical pollution.

articleTitle: A new Paradigm of Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Smart Agriculture is an emerging technology that uses sensors to collect real-time data, IoT for communication, Machine Learning for recognition. It also responds as per the user's instructions. The paper is proposing a method to protect the farmland from animals. The proposed method is a smart IoT device which will identify the threat and respond accordingly. The device also consists of sensors to monitor the soil conditions. The project entails the use of sophisticated technologies in agriculture, using IoT and automation. As technologies are continuously changing with evolving requirements, there is a need to continuously update the software used to control the hardware. The proposed hardware is tested in the filed with real inputs. The result shows the proposed model as promising solution for smart agriculture.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of 3-bit Flash and 5-bit Sigma Delta Hybrid ADC sub - Range Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Today with the advent of 5G networks, various high data rate applications like UHD video streaming, Remote Surgeries, Autonomous Vehicles, Smart Cities, Smart Buildings, Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality warrants newer designs of Gigabit Digital to Analog Converters and Analog to Digital Converters in 5G and 6G transceivers. In this paper, an 8-bit 3GS/s hybrid ADC for Low-power techniques are presented. It is designed as a sub-ranging architecture, with a flash 3-bit ADC in the first stage and a 4-channel timeinterleaved 5-bit Sigma Delta ADC in the second stage. The hybrid capacitive DAC modulates the segmented thermometer MSB capacitors and binary LSBs. The proposed architecture provides a very high sampling rate of 3 GSPS, good ENoB of 7.8 bit, low power consumption of 0.082 watts, SINAD of 49.6 dB, SNR 49 dB from 1.2v supply voltage.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mining Operations: A Novel Telematic Control Unit with Integrated Driver Management and Predictive Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Handling a mine site is a difficult task with heavy duty vehicles and industrial equipment, all operating at the same time. In the mining industry, the company fitted Telematic Control Unit (TCU) is not used effectively as in other vehicles. This is where TCU can be a savior. The word “Telematic” describes the technology which amalgamates telecommunications and informatics. It is an on-board device and a vital component designed to enhance operational efficiency and safety present in all vehicles. It integrates telematic technologies such as sensors to collect and transmit information about the vehicle's real time status such as temperature, fuel consumption. Along with the TCU, a new system that could give high security is crafted as mining accidents can occur from a variety of causes including leakage of poisonous gasses such as HS, methane, dust explosions which is known as Driver Management System (DMS). This system helps to monitor the driver's activities while driving the vehicle. This system is adaptable to all the heavy vehicles used in coal mines. It enables the fleet managers and operators to have full visibility of the vehicle's condition to improve their optimization. On the whole, this system employs predictive maintenance capabilities, eco-friendly approaches to achieve great competence among other devices.

articleTitle: Detection of Bloodstream Infections: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Bloodstream infections (BSIs) represent a critical threat to the health of hemodialysis patients, necessitating timely and precise detection for effective intervention and improved clinical outcomes. This paper explores the utilization of machine learning models for predicting BSIs in hemodialysis patients. Multiple algorithms, including Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), XGBoost, LightGBM, and Random Forest, were employed to analyze patient datasets. The models were assessed based on their classification accuracy. To further enhance performance, ensemble techniques―such as bagging, boosting, stacking, and voting―were applied, along with hyperparameter optimization using methods like grid search, randomized search, and Bayesian optimization. The study found that ensemble models and optimized hyperparameters yielded significant improvements in prediction accuracy, with XGBoost and Random Forest consistently achieving superior performance, reaching an accuracy of up to 79.8%. These findings underscore the potential of machine learning algorithms to aid in the early detection of BSIs, offering a valuable tool for improving patient care and reducing the associated health risks.

articleTitle: Optimised Computational Approaches for Heart Disease Prediction Using Dual Stage Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Heart disease continues to be a major global health challenge, ranking among the leading causes of death worldwide, making early diagnosis very crucial for improving patient outcomes and reducing healthcare costs. This study presents the development of a machine learning model aimed at predicting heart disease using health indicators and this data is sourced from the 2015 BRFSS (Behavioural Risk Factor Surveillance System). A stacked ensemble learning approach was utilized, combining multiple base models—Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and XGBoost—integrated with a Logistic Regression meta-model. The dataset was preprocessed through standardization and one-hot encoding to prepare the features for model training. The model was trained using 80% of the dataset, while the remaining 20% was used for testing, achieving an accuracy of highest possible. The model showed strong performance in predicting individuals without heart disease, though recall for detecting positive heart disease cases was lower, indicating a need for further refinement. This study highlights the effectiveness of stacking in predictive healthcare models and emphasizes the importance of addressing class imbalances to improve recall in identifying heart disease. Future improvements may focus on fine-tuning the model to enhance its sensitivity and applicability in real-world medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Dimensions of Internet of Things: A Comprehensive Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The Internet of Things is changing the way of living lives. Due to advances in technology, it is gaining utmost importance in today's world. The primary objective of this paper is to prospect the impact of IoT in daily life and also focus on highlighting its characteristics, evolution and emerging applications. Here, the architecture of IoT is also explored to integrate devices to accumulate real-time data and analyze it. The usage of IoT in smart cities, agriculture transportation and smart homes are also highlighted. Additionally, the challenges for its development are put through this study. A spike is observed in patents and publications which is illustrated using bibliometric analysis and it is found that 2022 acts as the apex where the key sources include “IEEE Access” and “Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems”. The authors highlighted the real-world understanding of this emerging technology and its potential in the future.

articleTitle: AI-Embedded Data Centres: Promoting Sustainability and Reducing Water Footprint
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications as always are growing at a rapid rate, which has raised the need for data centres and created threat to environment, especially with regard to water usage. The goal of this work is reducing the water consumption and footprint of AI-dependent data centres in order to promote sustainability. The goal of the research is to optimise water usage while preserving high performance and efficiency by investigating a variety of methods and instruments. Water recycling, hardware optimisation, water-efficient cooling techniques, and intelligent water management systems are important fields. The report offers significant perspectives on environmentally sustainable practices for data centres with AI integration, empowering operators to foster the development and progress of AI technologies while simultaneously making a positive impact on environmental preservation.

articleTitle: Integrating Segmentation and Neuro-Fuzzy Analysis for Efficient Glioma Brain Tumor Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach for the efficient prediction of glioma brain tumors by combining segmentation, Co-Active Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Expert System (CANFES), and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). The CANFES model facilitates adaptive and dynamic learning, enabling the capture of complex patterns within the data for precise tumor classification. Experimental results highlight the effectiveness of the proposed method, showcasing significant improvements in sensitivity, specificity, and other performance metrics. Tumor segmentation results were achieved using the proposed methodology across various parameters. By implementing the PCA + CANFES approach, the study attained impressive results, including a precision rate of 98.85%, accuracy of 98.73 %, specificity of 98.56%, and sensitivity of 97.60%, 17.94 HD(cm), 0.911 k and 0.867 Cohen's kappa. Comparative analysis reveals that the PCA + CANFES method outperforms conventional approaches, demonstrating its potential for enhanced glioma tumor prediction.

articleTitle: Classification of Brain Tumours in Medical Images Through the Application of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Early detection of brain tumors is crucial, yet existing segmentation methods have not yielded satisfactory results. Brain tumors are deadlier than many other cancers, primarily because their complex structures often merge with normal tissues, complicating classification. This study explores machine learning techniques to classify brain tumors—specifically Glioma, Meningioma, and Pituitary tumors—using an MRI scan dataset. We employ convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and ensemble approaches, integrating advanced pre-processing, feature extraction, and model optimization for improved accuracy. Our models achieve state-of-the-art precision, recall, and F1 scores, outperforming traditional methods. Future work will expand the dataset and incorporate multimodal imaging and federated learning to improve generalization and privacy.

articleTitle: Cattle Skin Diseases Classification Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Cattle are essential for products like milk, curd, cheese etc. and cattle farms also increase overall revenue for farmers. Cattle are prone to extremely contagious viruses that can cause foot and mouth diseases(FMD), infectious bovine keratoconjunctivitis, and lumpy skin disease(LSD), all of which are financially detrimental to the agriculture industry. Early diagnosis is critical for controlling these disorders. The ailment commonly causes chronic debility, stunted growth, decreased milk production, infertility, abortion, and occasionally even death. It does not endanger people's health, but it can be damaging to animal wellbeing and affect production outputs negatively. owing to lack of veterinary expert it is becoming difficult to diagnose these diseases in initial stages and it leads to death of cows especially in countries of Asia and Africa which suffers from shortage of livestock owing to massive spread of this diseases in cattle. The suggested machine learning models will classify cattle photos and detect if the cattle is suffering any skin condition like Lumpy, FMD or not. After utilizing two machine learning algorithms to identify the illness, we selected the most accurate model by comparing metrics like accuracy, precision, and recall.

articleTitle: Advanced Strategies for Identifying Cryptominer Malware: Enhancing Security in Cryptocurrency Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Cryptocoin mining has increased cases of cryptominer malware that has posed a significant threat to the users and the organizations. This paper focused on improving detection strategies of cryptominer malware in an effort to improve safety in cryptographic environments. We discussed several methodologies for detection: behavior-based analysis, signature detection, and machine learning approaches and indicated their efficacy in the recognition of threats from the cryptominer menace. The traditional approaches of security are also discussed, and a hybrid approach is proposed that depicts multiple detection strategies to increase the accuracy without generating false positives. Organizations can now put better security measures in place against cryptominer malware by leveraging these sophisticated mechanisms for malware detection, ensuring integrity and security within their cryptocurrency operations.

articleTitle: Advancing Stuttering Detection with Time Delay Neural Networks and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Stuttering is a speech disorder characterized by interruptions in speech fluency, posing significant challenges to effective communication. Although recent advancements in machine learning have contributed to stuttering detection, ensuring consistent accuracy across diverse speech patterns remains challenging. This paper introduces a novel deep learning framework that leverages Time Delay Neural Networks (TDNN) and attention mechanisms to capture both temporal and contextual speech patterns, specifically aimed at detecting stuttering. The proposed model is trained and evaluated using the SEP-28K dataset, which provides a comprehensive set of labeled stuttering speech samples. By integrating TDNN and attention mechanisms, the model focuses on critical disfluency cues, thereby enhancing detection reliability. Experimental results show that the model achieves an accuracy of 73.56%, a precision of 77.04%, a recall of 90.53%, and an F1-score of 83.15%, indicating robust performance in identifying stuttering events. These results lay the groundwork for improving automated stuttering detection systems with a focus on real-time applications and scalability across various speech datasets.

articleTitle: A Review on Edge Computing: Security Considerations and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The foundation of Edge Computing revolves around the redistribution of computational tasks to leverage the currently underutilized computational capacities present at the network's edge. Particularly in the privacy and security industry, the expansion of cloud, IoT, and edge computing models raises serious concerns regarding data privacy and its protection from unauthorized access. However, adequate data privacy solutions for the privacy and security industry require thorough research. This document focuses on the security challenges inherent in edge computing, analysing the solutions researchers have proposed to mitigate these security concerns. Additionally, it provides a comprehensive review of cloud and edge computing, including a detailed comparison of current research, characteristics, requirements for enabling edge computing, and the associated challenges. The discourse further includes considerations for establishing a secure edge computing architecture, presenting various recommended solutions.

articleTitle: Detection and Prediction of Deep Fakes Using Advanced Deep Learning Algorithms A Novel Approach to Enhance Media Authenticity
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study, present a novel method with a unique combination of powerful deep learning techniques, specifically Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) networks, to detect and predict deep fakes. Deep fakes are a serious threat to media legitimacy because deep fakes produce very believable fake information. To exploit LSTMs' perceptive skills at analyzing temporal sequences, we exploit minute discrepancies in video frames beyond what traditional models can: Training and validation accuracy graph indicates 93% accuracy of the proposed model after training with diversified true and deepfake video datasets. This helps to show how well LSTM can tell true from false information, and made a reliable way to boost media authenticity. The paper provides evidence of how the results from our method can be used to improve the identification of deepfakes in order to facilitate additional efforts to defend digital material against the growing threat of media manipulation.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Based on the Design and Development of an Interactive Virtual Museum
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The Augmented Reality-Based Virtual Museum project aims to transform the traditional museum experience by utilizing AR technology to provide users with an immersive and interactive way to explore exhibits. Through AR-enabled devices like smartphones, users can view 3D models of artifacts in their real-world environment, allowing them to examine and interact with exhibits from any location. This project enhances learning by offering features such as rotating, zooming, and exploring objects in detail, along with media content like audio guides to provide deeper context. By making museums accessible remotely, the project opens up cultural and educational opportunities for users around the world. Developed using Unity and C#, with AR capabilities powered by ARCore, the Virtual Museum combines technology and education to create a dynamic, personalized museum experience, engaging users in new ways and offering a modern approach to learning about history, art, and science.

articleTitle: Software Defined Network Level for Local Processing and Global Processing of IoT-Fog Network Events
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: A Software Defined Network (SDN) is a modern networking approach that makes it possible to directly program and manage network traffic, while also simplifying the underlying infrastructure for applications and services. It works by separating the decision-making (control plane) from the actual data transmission (data plane), giving greater flexibility and control over how networks operate. Fog Computing architecture and Internet of Things (IoT) devices are combined to create IoT-Fog Networks, which aim to solve the issues of latency, scalability, bandwidth limitations, and real-time data processing. The intermediary processing resources known as fog nodes are situated nearer the network's edge in fog computing. The majority of fog devices are not very computationally or memory-intensive. The task of skillfully handling these constraints in order to fulfill the requirements of multiple applications is difficult. Samples in the current IoT-Fog network are overly delayed in their communication or, on occasion, may be lost due to communication and processing overload due to congestion between devices and gateways. One way to address this is to provide a method that is effective for handling IoT-Fog Events in Software Defined Network (SDN), both locally and globally.

articleTitle: Parkinson's Disease Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Parkinsin's disease (PD) is very important to make early diagnoses of such neurodegenerative disorders leading to progressive motor and non-motor symptoms. Traditional methods of diagnosis rely purely on subjective clinical evaluation. Recent studies on machine and deep learning offer new avenues toward voice-based automated PD detection, which is minimally invasive and highly accessible. In this study, we analyze the performance of three deep architectures in the context of classifying PD from vocal features: CNN, RNN, and a combined architecture that uses both RNN combined with LSTM networks. We preprocess the data using the normalization method and perform train-test splitting for training our dataset. Each model is architected and trained with specific architectural choices to try to capture the underlying patterns in data. These metrics include accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score that are used to evaluate the performance of these models. Preliminary results indicate that RNN + LSTM outperforms other architectures concerning accuracy and robustness, hence indicating its superior suitability for classifying time-series for PD detection purposes. Results of this study contribute to the growing body of evidence for advanced machine learning techniques in the early diagnosis of Parkinson's disease and pave the path for further studies to validate the model on larger datasets and possibly more features.

articleTitle: Garment-Specific Style Transfer Using VGG19 and Semantic Segmentation for High-Fidelity Clothing Image Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This paper will present a new style transfer technique, applied specifically to clothing images, by using the VGG19 neural network together with a semantic segmentation approach. The process involves the creation of a segmenting network where the clothing is properly separated from the background such that this style transfer technique may be more specific and targeted. This targeted approach captures the important garment features, including textures and boundary details of the garments, during the transformation. To further enhance the quality of the results, it introduces loss functions custom-designed to preserve the smoothness of the fabric and the integrity of edges of the garment. In this method, proposed here, through immense experimentation, the performance in output is superbly better than that of conventionally used techniques as the quality of the output visuals will be more accurate with all the structural elements of the garments.

articleTitle: A Novel Dense-Net Deep Neural Network Method for Classify Tuberculosis Stages Using Chest X-Ray Images with Enhanced Features
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Although chest X-ray (CXR) imaging is critical for the detection of potentially lethal disorders, interpretation may arise because to similarities between distinct lung conditions. In response, researchers proposed CBAMWDnet, a new deep learning model for tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis based on computed tomography (CXR) images. To successfully collect geographical and contextual data, the model includes the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into its architecture, which is based on the Wide Dense Net (WDnet). Pre-processing using an enhanced Gabor filter improves image quality prior to applying the model. We test the model using three well-known datasets: Shenzhen, Montgomery, and Indiana. The results indicate that the Shenzhen dataset performs the best. CBAMWDnet beats previous techniques by better classifying tuberculosis (TB) into normal, primary, latent, and active stages. This complex classification engine improves both accuracy and dependability.

articleTitle: Datapath Optimization of Digital Finite Impulse Response (FIR) Filter for Aerospace Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: A Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter is mainly used in Digital Communication Systems for Aerospace applications like navigation and control, autopilots and avionics and satellite imaging onboard spacecraft. This paper depicts an implementation of a digital FIR filter. The filter is designed based one of the novel solutions for the datapath and operational timing optimization technique using Genetic Algorithm (GA). It is a datapath and controller-based design We have verified the reduction in the operational timing after using the datapath designed using the algorithm compared to the datapath without using the algorithm. We have achieved the reduction in the delay by 14 delay units after implementing the datapath with algorithm.

articleTitle: Mitigating Climate Change: Utilizing Global Warming Through ARIMA Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Climate change and global warming are some surging subjects characterized by unprecedented temperature increases in temperature, raining patterns and rising sea levels, contributed largely by human activities such as deforestation and burning fossils, etc. This paper concentrates on comprehensive dataset including parameters such as global temperatures on land by city, state, country, etc. collected from the internet and processed to predict and augment the future forecasting of the climate in the upcoming years. The use of time-forecasting algorithms has been used for the analysis and prediction process. The dataset used is a time series dataset and thus the use of ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) modelling technique for an accurate forecast. The paper has undergone substantial research and studies to bring the finest results and assist humans towards a better future. Additionally, it provides insights about possible mediation and preventive measures, contributing to climate control awareness. Artificial Intelligence has made enormous changes in the field of nature conservation and is tending to contribute more in the upcoming future. This paper deals an aspect where we can use AI and its various tools in order to analyze the various aspects of global warming and find solutions for the upcoming problems.

articleTitle: Salesforce Release Pipeline Optimization: A Relative Study of Azure DevOps, Copado and Jenkins
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Salesforce is the leading CRM software for customizable software applications; thus, it requires advanced DevOps solutions and automated deployment processes. Creating the pipelines and DevOps Process is a big challenge for salesforce applications because of the dependencies with metadata, multiple sandbox environments and org dependencies. This paper discusses the different types of tools that can be used to create the salesforce DevOps pipelines and their effectiveness in performing seamless automated deployments. Also, this paper discusses the differences between these tools and ease of deployment process, ease of integrations between the other applications, scalability of these tools and automation between these tools. The real time scenarios of the study are used for the simulation in corporate world deployments in salesforce, roll back procedures and code quality check. By comparing these results between the tools, we can come up with recommendations based on the environments and types of different clouds. Finally, this paper's conclusion will provide the salesforce DevOps environments best practices and the provides an outlook for the further development in the process to improve the DevOps pipelines for salesforce deployments.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of IEEE 802.11p and IEEE 802.11bd for Advanced V2X Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The rapid advancement of cooperative automated driving and the communication of vehicle-to-everything (V2X) technologies have prompted in need for next-generation wireless standards. IEEE 802.11bd, designed as the successor to IEEE 802.11p, integrates key features such as dual carrier modulation, high-density midambles, and range extension to meet high demands for increased data rates, extended communication range, and enhanced reliability. This paper presents a detail difference within IEEE 802.11p, IEEE 802.11bd, focusing on three essential metrics: throughput, communication range, and packet reception ratio (PRR). PRR, a critical indicator of communication reliability, measures the percentage of successfully received packets over a given period. Simulation-based evaluations of these metrics show that IEEE 802.11bd significantly enhances performance than IEEE 802.11p, mainly when compared with the data transmission efficiency and reliability. Here results highlight the advantages of IEEE 802.11bd in modern V2X applications, where faster and more reliable communication is essential for enabling cooperative driving systems. Furthermore, the study underscores the importance of PRR in evaluating communication standards, as it reflects both the reliability and consistency of data transmission in varying conditions. Our analysis provides deeper insights into the key benefits of adopting IEEE 802.11bd for future vehicular communication systems. Overall, IEEE 802.11bd offers superior capabilities over IEEE 802.11p, making it a more viable solution to reach the rigid necessities of upcoming V2X applications, including those in cooperative automated driving environments.

articleTitle: Harnessing 5G for Sustainable Energy Efficiency in Modern Telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study delves into the potential of 5G technology to significantly enhance energy efficiency within modern telecommunications networks, thereby supporting sustainable development goals. As the demand for constant connectivity escalates, the telecom industry faces mounting challenges related to energy consumption and environmental impact. This research examines how 5G's advanced features—such as massive MIMO, dynamic spectrum sharing, and network slicing—contribute to reducing energy usage in network infrastructure. By exploring case studies and practical implementations, the study highlights the clear benefits of 5G in lowering the carbon footprint of communication networks. The findings aim to inform industry stakeholders, policymakers, and researchers about the symbiotic relationship between 5G technology and energy efficiency, ultimately guiding the development of more sustainable and environmentally friendly communication networks.

articleTitle: Constrained Normalised Maximum Complex Correntropy Criterion for Adaptive Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This paper proposes the constrained normalized maximum complex correntropy criterion CNMCCC, which introduces a normalization approach to enhance stability and ensure convergence by mitigating the effects of input power variations. Additionally, the algorithm incorporates a set of linear constraints that ensure the desired signal is passed without distortion while minimizing interference from other directions. By optimizing the correntropy between the desired and output signals, the proposed method significantly improves beamforming performance in complex environments where traditional methods are less effective. Through theoretical analysis and simulations, we demonstrate that the beamformer based on the proposed algorithm outperforms classical algorithms in robustness, interference suppression, and convergence speed. The results confirm that it is well-suited for adaptive beamforming applications in non-Gaussian, and interference-prone environments.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Diabetic Retinopathy Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a global disease that leads to imaginative and foresighted impairment and is considered the largest cause of it. The progress from No DR to Proliferative DR is critical in portraying the progression of the disease, and hence, therefore classification of those stages is very crucial in its timely diagnosis and treatment. The paper compares the performance of four deep learning models: VGG16, VGG19, Inception V3, and InceptionResNetV2 for the classification of DR in its five stages. VGG16 and VGG19 had an excellent performance when it came to classifying the early levels but poor in the more complex tiers of high-level classification. Inception V3, with its advantage on a multi-scale function extraction, achieved good results in the advanced class and was classified under both Moderate and Severe DR but failed for the most challenging cases. The model, InceptionResNetV2, combined the Inception modules with residual connections and outperformed all alternative fashions by achieving more than 96% accuracy in all tiers while showing top accuracy in Severe DR at 98.05%. The results showed the importance of multi-scale function extraction and residual learning for effective DR classing, especially for better tier differentiation.

articleTitle: Personalized Activity Recommendation System for Cardiovascular Patients Using Heart Rate and ECG/EKG Data from Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Worldwide, cardiovascular diseases such as heart disease, hypertension, and high blood pressure are leading causes of death. These patients need proper management of physical activity because it can be favorable to health outcome and prevent complications. In this research, we present a personalized activity recommendation system for individuals with cardiovascular conditions. It utilizes real-time heart rate and ECG/EKG data from wearable devices, such as smartwatches and fitness monitors. The proposed system analyzes these biometric signals to provide tailored activity recommendations that are safe and consistent with the user's existing heart health. To keep the algorithms in constant adaptation to the physiological data, patterns written in machine learning algorithms are used to analyze and create continuous changes in recommendations depending on user conditions and trends. The system is designed to help patients stay active and minimize health risks while taking into account both real-time and historical health data. The approach improves the effectiveness of remote health monitoring and enables personalized and preventative healthcare for cardiovascular patients.

articleTitle: Image to Audio Using LLM for Blind People
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Blind people face many difficulties while engaging with their surroundings. This project is all about creating innovative solutions for the blind people by providing the information in the format of audio. Image-to-Audio transformation system specifically designed for natural language understanding using Large Language Model (LLM).The system will capture a picture or video of the situation present in front of the blind person and then provide descriptions about the images. The objective is to provide guidelines for blind people by understanding their surroundings through an LLM model and provide audio response. The CLIP model analyzes the objects, scenes, text etc.. and provides relevant information. The extracted visual data is then passed through GTTs (Google-Text-To-Speech) to create rich audio descriptions. It provides accurate and detailed representation of the visual content, allowing blind people to understand their surroundings. The project involves integrating convolutional neural networks and Large Language Model (e.g GPT-4) technologies to create a real-time image-to-text system for blind individuals. The CNN model is used to calculate the distance of the object from the user. We are integrating the Google Assistants to open the app automatically by the blind people with help of their voice.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi -Mobility Modular Robot for Surveillance Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The application of robotic-drones in search and rescue operations, as well as supply delivery, often requires the integration of multiple robots, each optimized for specific tasks.
