These robotic drones must navigate challenging terrains, locate individuals, and relay real-time data. A key challenge lies in efficiently coordinating different types of drones while ensuring reliability during critical missions. In this work, we propose the development of a multi-mobility modular robot, a versatile robotic platform capable of switching locomotion modes to adapt to various environments. Powered by the AMD KR260 processor, this advanced robot is equipped with morphing appendages that enable it to fly, roll, crawl, and climb, allowing seamless transitions between modes. This makes the robot suitable for tasks such as search and rescue, healthcare delivery to remote areas, and environmental monitoring in rugged terrains. The AMD KR260 processor provides the computational power necessary for real-time sensor data processing, control algorithms, and mode transitions without delay. The operator interface allows intuitive control over the robot and easy selection of operational modes. Extensive field testing has been conducted to validate the performance of the proposed modular robot in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Digital Literacy for Rural Communities: Bridging the Knowledge Gap
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: In our fast-moving tech world, digital literacy is the key. But access to digital tools, and knowledge about how to use them, remains limited in many rural communities. Focused on the central issues that these communities struggle with: occluded infrastructure, little to no internet or network access and an overall poor level of cyber capability. To address these information concerns, a mobile-based digital literacy platform with modules directed at the specific requirements of rural populace was put forth. The ambition is that by providing people with the digital skills to thrive in a tech-led world, it will improve education and health outcomes, as well as provide new ways for those looking to secure government services. In sum, this study indicates that digital literacy in rural communities indeed can be improved greatly with appropriate courses and resources. Digital literacy has emerged as a fundamental skill in the 21st century, essential for navigating an increasingly complex digital landscape. This research examines the concept of digital literacy, its components, and its importance across diverse domains, with a focus on its role in enabling individuals to effectively access, evaluate, and utilize digital information. This paper explores digital literacy from a scientific perspective, analyzing its impact on education, employment, and societal engagement while addressing strategies to improve digital literacy in various populations.

articleTitle: Development of Solar-Powered Paddy Sowing Vehicle Using ESP32 for Automated Agricultural Application
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Automation in agriculture involves integrating electrical and mechanical systems to replace manual tasks, addressing concerns about the impact of harsh weather on worker health. Agricultural workers are frequently exposed to challenging conditions, which can lead to health issues such as back pain, respiratory problems, and allergies due to prolonged hours and pesticide exposure. Traditional semi-automated sowing machines still require a considerable amount of human involvement, particularly for steering and direction control in the field. The adoption of full automation in agriculture has the potential to enhance efficiency and reduce the reliance on manual labor. A Remote-Controlled Paddy Sowing Vehicle is designed to reduce the need for human effort in the field. This vehicle features a sturdy steel frame with a plywood cover and is powered by a battery that is charged via a solar panel. The vehicle's movement is managed by a wiper motor, and it is equipped with a microcontroller that has an integrated Wi-Fi module. This allows for remote operation using a smartphone within a range of 50–200 meters. The seed sowing mechanism is built into the frame, and the motor driver module is controlled by the microcontroller, which greatly decreases the necessity for manual labor. The smartphone can be used as a remote control for the vehicle by connecting the microcontroller to the Remote XY application. The primary objective is to streamline agricultural processes through automation, thus keeping workers out of wet paddy fields and reducing their exposure to health risks.

articleTitle: Exploring Brain-Computer Interface with CNS Technologies to Enhance Communication Abilities in Pseudocoma Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) technologies in improving communication abilities for Locked-In Syndrome or Pseudocoma Patients. Pseudocoma is a condition where individuals are conscious but unable to speak or move due to a paralytic situation. BCI technology allows direct communication between the external devices and the brain, allowing patients to control devices using their brain signals. This paper focuses on some possible solutions based on motor imagery signals generated by pseudocoma patient which are either used as single or double-triggering signals enabling them to communicate, control their environment, and potentially regain some independence. The findings of this research discuss the possibilities of enhancing the lives of patients with Pseudocoma by using motor imagery signals blended with AI-based software solutions. Also, it shows an application architecture that can be integrated with BCI systems to help pseudocoma patients express themselves and interact with others. The study also highlights the neuro-technology which uses neural interfaces to read or write information into the CNS (Central Nervous System) which can be a significant potential of BCI technology in empowering pseudocoma patients to communicate effectively and improve their overall well-being.

articleTitle: Comparison of Various ML Algorithms for Predicting Personality Using Balanced Bagging Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Understanding people's personalities makes it easier to understand their ideas, beliefs, emotions, and reactions to particular circumstances. Regardless of the kind of relationship (friends, employer and employee, seller and buyer, etc.), it would benefit all parties and possibly result in improved relationships. The popularity of community media as a means of assertiveness and awareness has raised curiosity around the Myers-Briggs type Indicator (MBTI), a tool for analysing personality traits. In research, we have implemented three machine learning algorithms logistic regression, linear support vector classification and random forest. We also practised balanced bagging classifier to cope with the imbalanced data. The investigation found that machine learning algorithm understand and classify the personality well with balanced bagging classifier. In all the three algorithm logistic regression generates good F1 score with balanced bagging algorithm.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review of Machine Learning Based Classification and Prediction Models for Grains (Maize)
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Machine learning is widely used and an important technology for classification and grading models for crops. Several machine learning algorithms are in practice to prepare classification models that are applied to various crops for seed variety classification, seed defect identification, and crop yield. In this systematic literature review (SLR), a study of 30 papers is included to extract the algorithms used, features used, and accuracy of the prediction algorithm. According to this study, most classification algorithms used morphological features with various imaging techniques to classify seed variety and seed defects. Most classification models used machine learning algorithms using large datasets and deep learning-based solutions using feature selection and extraction with different imaging techniques. In this paper, a classification model using morphological features of maize seeds is proposed as future research to overcome manual classification limitations and classify the quality of maize grains based on their size.

articleTitle: Complex Fuzzy Sets Based Rank Data Processing and Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving e-commerce industry, displaying an optimal product list (precise and best-matched item set) is one of the most challenging and high-priority tasks. Ranking these item sets faces three main issues: rank reversal phenomena, the satisfiability of the transitivity property, and decomposed/composed rank problems. Additionally, on the client side, online sales are hindered by insufficient understanding of all products and limited knowledge, additionally, lack of evaluation time is also a major concern. To address these challenges, proposed system evaluates product features using a multicriteria group decision-making method based on improved Z-numbers (IVZ). We have extensively performed ranking using uncertain Z-numbers for recommender systems. These rankings are compared with the ranking provided by 84 different participants who kindly participated in the survey. It is noteworthy that the result of the experiments and ranking from the survey are similar. Moreover, we have also proposed multicriteria group decision-making method and exploited entropy, distance measure, and aggregation operator. We argue that the ordered list of products demonstrates robustness and resistance to the previously mentioned ranking issues.

articleTitle: Beyond Shelves: The Fusion of IoT and AI for Dynamic Retail Personalization
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The IoT-enabled smart purchasing cart system integrates Radio-Frequency identity (RFID) technology, which uses electromagnetic fields to mechanically perceive and track tags connected to merchandise, along picture popularity and weight sensors, to revolutionize retail operations. through automating real-time product identity, permitting dynamic inventory management, and offering self-carrier billing, it minimizes redundant purchaser dealing with and decreases checkout wait times. Supported by way of a robust verbal exchange network linking smart cabinets, carts, and a central server, this system enhances both patron revel in and operational performance. It transforms traditional shopping into an intuitive, information-driven technique, putting a foundation for destiny retail innovation.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in the Pocket: Factors Influencing Generation Z's Intention to Use AI-Powered Mobile Banking Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The survey examines the factors affecting the intention to utilize AI-powered features in mobile banking among Generation Z customers. Technology Acceptance Method was extended with perceived trust (PT) and subjective norms (SN) to found users' intentions and attitudes towards using AI in mobile banking. An online google form was distributed to engineering graduate students to collect data. The suggested theories were tested with the use of structural equation modeling (SEM). The results display that views about AI and the intention to employ it in mobile banking are positively influenced by perceived usefulness (PU) and perceived ease of use (PEU). Additionally, it was discovered that the intention to employ AI in mobile banking was significantly positively impacted by SN and PT. There are significant theoretical and practical ramifications to the subject. Theoretically, it broadens the applicability of the technological acceptance method to m-banking powered by AI and offers a thorough grasp of the adoption determinants. Managerially, the findings guide banks in developing effective techniques to promote the adoption of AI-powered features, like emphasizing the usefulness and ease of use of these technologies, building trust, and leveraging social influences. The study underscores the significance of catering to the unique preferences of Generation Z customers to drive the successful integration of AI in mobile banking.

articleTitle: Review on Need of Read Time DSS for Effective Pest and Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Farmers today face persistent challenges in effectively managing pests and diseases, often relying on reactive measures that lead to considerable crop damage and loss. Although technological advancements, including the Internet of Things (IoT) and predictive analytics, offer transformative potential for agriculture, many farmers still lack access to cost-effective, scalable solutions that deliver real-time insights. This study investigates the need for an integrated, real-time Decision Support System (DSS) that combines IoT devices with predictive analytics to facilitate proactive crop management. By leveraging IoT sensors to monitor environmental factors like weather and soil moisture, alongside machine learning algorithms for forecasting pest and disease outbreaks, this system aims to equip farmers with the tools to take preemptive action. The proposed solution emphasizes scalability and affordability, designed to empower farmers with actionable insights that enhance crop protectionand boost productivity.

articleTitle: Smart Devices, Smarter Security: The Blockchain-IoT Revolution
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The integration of Blockchain technology with the Internet of Things (IoT) provides a robust solution to address security, privacy, and scalability challenges in traditional IoT systems. Centralized architectures often suffer from single points of failure and vulnerabilities to unauthorized data access. Blockchain's decentralized, tamper-resistant nature enhances data integrity, trust, and authentication, offering a secure framework for IoT communications and data management. This paper presents a comprehensive framework combining Blockchain and IoT, outlining key architectural components, data protocols, and smart contracts. It explores how Blockchain addresses privacy concerns while improving decentralized trust and system resilience. Scalability challenges are analyzed, with solutions such as Layer 2 technologies and optimized consensus mechanisms proposed to improve performance. Real-world applications in smart cities, healthcare, and supply chains demonstrate the framework's utility. Experimental analysis highlights significant improvements in security and efficiency, emphasizing Blockchain's potential to enable secure, scalable IoT ecosystems for diverse industries.

Author Keywords: IoT Security and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Deep Learning Models for Plant Disease Detection with a Focus on Apple Leaf Pathologies
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Effective agriculture and the economy are the identification of plant diseases. Conventional means for diagnosing plant disease are laborious since they call for a lot of effort, time, and knowledge. Recently, academics, researchers, and practitioners have given a lot of attention to an important study topic automatic disease spotting of plants. Like a flash, diseases first manifest itself on plant leaf, Machine learning and automated analysis can assist in recognizing it. This cutting-edge review has conducted detailed research to assess the viability of applying AI based models to categorize plant disorders. The pathogens and infections of various crops are examined in this study. A comprehensive study of the many procedures required in classifying and detecting using ML and AI to diagnose plant diseases is presented. Additionally, several online databases for identifying plant diseases have been given. In addition to this, a thorough analysis of a variety of currently used classifying models based on ML and DL proposed by many researchers for different crops is explained. This includes information on how well each model performed, the dataset it was based on, and the technique used to extract features. Lastly, a variety of concerns are highlighted and examined when employing DL & ML to predict plant pathogens.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on the Efficacy of Machine Learning Algorithms for Detecting DDoS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Denial-of-service (DoS) and distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks are blatant attempts to prevent legitimate users from reaching a service or from using the service they already are using. DDoS attacks are possible due to the internet's current design, and an attacker gain control over many machines by exploiting their weak factors and setting up different targeted networks, also known as “Botnets”. Once an attacker is ready with the targeted network, they can launch a massive, coordinated attack against a target or targets. As new attacks are constantly being created, and the number of hosts that may be attacked online continues to grow, several various DDoS attack detection and prevention methods have been developed to combat this growing threat. In this paper, we discuss a wide range of DDoS attacks and methods, as well as countermeasures. This review is useful because it addresses many different approaches to stopping DDoS attacks, such as detecting them, defending against them, minimizing their impacts, tracing their origins, answering unresolved problems, and overcoming research difficulties.

Index Terms: Distributed Denial Of Service Attack Detection

articleTitle: Robust Face Recognition in Low-Light Environments Using Thermal Imaging and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Traditional face detection systems are all primarily based on visible light. They have a very poor rate in low illumination or no illumination at all. To counter the problemsas described above, we have come up with a high-powered face detection system that comes from the principle of thermal imaging technology and captures infrared radiations emitted from the human body, thus ensuring that there is a guaran- teed successful detection even in cases of scarce illumination. Our methodology commences with detailed data preprocessing, which includes cleaning the data to remove all invalid images and proper labeling of matched and mismatched thermal and visible image pairs to enable ease in binary classification. The normalized pixel values into the range [0, 1] have enhanced the model's stability during training. Furthermore, segmentation techniques have been applied along the facial regions; these improved identification accuracy and reduced the input size goinginto the CNN. The Siamese network architecture centred on our system, composed of two identical subnetworks that learn similarities through contrastive loss, achieves validation accuracy of 96.84%. The techniques applied to stabilize training against overfitting are batch normalization and dropout regularization. In general, the results of our Siamese model for determining whether two image pairs are matched or mismatched reached a remarkable accuracy of 97.69%. This eventually shows the strong potential of thermal imaging for improving face detection in poor illumination conditions and significantly contributing to the further development of cross-domain recognition systems.

articleTitle: Review of Machine Translation Systems for Verse (Poetic) Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) encompasses the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), which aims to enable machines to perform human-like tasks. This research focuses on Machine Translation Systems that convert poetic texts from Hindi to English. NLP is central to these systems, with key components and stages that guide the translation process. Different types of language translators are discussed, including knowledge-based, corpus-based, and Neural Machine Translation (NMT) systems. NMT, using artificial neural networks, predicts word sequences to improve translation accuracy. The Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score assesses translation quality, which applies a formula to analyze translated text. After reviewing various translators., the study highlights CDEC, a widely used Statistical Machine Translation (SMT) tool for NLP. CDEC is efficient and flexible, offering decoding, alignment, and model training tools. Despite advancements in machine translation, translating poetry, especially from Hindi to English, presents challenges due to the aesthetic and cultural elements embedded in the original text. The review concludes by emphasizing the need to improve existing systems to address these complexities in poetic translations better, such as those of the Ramayana.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Analysis of Morbidity and Mortality Disparities Among Individuals with and Without Disabilities Using Machine Learning and Big Data Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study uses extensive information from government agencies and academic organizations to propose a novel method of studying death and morbidity rates in India. Our focus is on the frequency of different diseases in different age groups, genders, and rural-urban contexts. To provide useful insights, our approach combines sophisticated data visualization methods with predictive analytics models. To investigate particular health trends, users can filter data by state, age group, and other demographics. With the use of this platform, politicians and healthcare professionals should be able to better allocate resources, create well-informed policies, and enhance health outcomes. Our method delivers a comprehensive perspective of present and future health trends by integrating retrospective and predictive analysis, highlighting high-risk regions and people for focused interventions.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis on the Performance of Students in a University System in India
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Analyzing students’ academic performance has become a major concern for universities and schools of higher education. It has become critical to plan and manage educational methodology well. This present study aims to analyze the performance of students from pre- to post-COVID-era. Statistical tools and methods such as ANOVA and the t-test are implemented to analyze the students’ performance. Actual results of university examinations for the undergraduate students of four different courses Bachelor's in Business Administration, Bachelor's in Computer Applications, Bachelor's in Commerce, and Bachelor's in Journalism and Mass Communication have been taken from a state university. It has been found that despite the learning rate is slow during covid time, the marks are not reflected the same. Marks are inflated in online evaluation system and things are getting back to pre-covid average marks once normalcy is attained.

articleTitle: Exploring the Synergy of Artificial and Computational Intelligence for Technological Advancements
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Due to the ongoing advancements in science and technology, it seems that artificial intelligence and computers have encountered a limitation in their progress. Contemporary scientific research requires more sophisticated interconnection technology to ensure the continued progress of science and technology. Amidst this setting, the technology of Internet of Things (IoT) has progressively been visible to individuals. This technology will significantly impact human lifestyle and quality of life, and the Internet of Things has seen substantial progress. Information technology is intricately intertwined with the lives of citizens. The integration of information technology with the IoT is aimed at maximizing the technological advancement of the Internet of Things, with Internet technology serving as the central component. The use of artificial intelligence and computer intelligence in Internet technology is versatile, and issues pertaining to artificial intelligence and computing intelligence are progressively emerging. Artificial intelligence and computational intelligence play a significant role in the Internet of Things. However, their application process is challenging and lacks creativity, necessitating ongoing improvements at the application level. This study examines the use of artificial intelligence and computational intelligence in the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Algorithms for Recognizing and Digitizing Scanned Kannada Printed and Handwritten Documents
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: In this research, we explore the recognition of scanned and handwritten Kannada characters using machine learning, specifically employing the Inception-v3 model. Unlike static printed documents, digitized handwritten texts can be edited, This is essential in several applications like speech conversion, language translation, and the conservation of historical documents. Kannada, a language with a complex script, presents a challenge for text recognition, particularly when dealing with handwritten characters. The Inception-v3 The model was selected since it can improve feature propagation, enhance feature reuse, as well as lower the vanishing gradient problem. We tested the model on two datasets-kannada-ocr-test-images-with-ground-truth and Scribd - Labour Law 1 - Hand Written Notes Kannada in A4 Sheets-to recognize scanned and handwritten Kannada characters. The results showed a testing accuracy of 83.1% for scanned printed images and 86.7% for scanned handwritten images. For comparison, the Tesseract OCR tool, a widely-used standard OCR system, was also tested, and while it performed well on both types of images, Inception-v3 outperformed it in precision, recall, and F1-score. This demonstrates the superior performance of deep learning models like Inception-v3 over traditional OCR tools in recognizing complex handwritten scripts. The suggested system offers an extensive amount of opportunity for real-world applications, especially in automating the digitization of Kannada administrative documents and preserving historical texts. Additionally, it could be extended to other Indian languages, further enhancing its applicability in multilingual regions of India.

articleTitle: The Intersection of Generative AI and Wearable Health Devices: A Privacy-Focused Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study examines the privacy implications associated with the intersection of Gen-AI in wearable health devices. Wearables have the potential to revolutionize healthcare for predictive diagnoses. This technological intersection has privacy concerns. Generative AI is trained using a large amount of data that has ethical considerations. The objective of this research is to explore the privacy implications using Generative AI in wearable healthcare devices where consumer trust is concerned. The study is based on mixed method approach. Through a thorough review of literature and primary data collected from 90 wearable device users, the study highlights the dual nature of Gen AI, wearables of health monitoring and privacy concerns. The results indicate that there are security implications for the use of Generative AI in wearables. The study summarizes that users should be made aware of the privacy implications of their data collection when they use the devices regularly as the collected information is personal. It is suggested that companies developing wearable devices should aim to build transparent privacy policies in the context of consumer awareness of data protection for the use of data generated by smart devices. The study contributes to the literature on wearable devices and their data usage by revealing the impact of privacy concerns.

articleTitle: A Framework for Reinforced Student Learning Using Concept Maps
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This research set up a basis for automated assessment of concept maps, measuring the structural understanding of students for a specific topic. This framework uses a novel scoring algorithm to identify strong and weak concepts for each student, as well as the entire class. The students are clustered on the basis of the concept scores-so that the tutors can target remedials effectively to help reinforce learning. In the iterations that followed, showed a decrease in the number of clusters suggesting that students were comprehending various aspects of topic learned consecutively better over time (remediation). The framework was implemented with an experimental group of students. In a subsequent class test on the topic, the experimental group performed significantly better than control group. The reinforcement model not only rationalizes the assessment, but also allows instructors to help the students to reconstruct their knowledge in each iteration.

articleTitle: Interdisciplinary Perspectives on the Convergence of Healthcare, Artificial Intelligence, and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This study advocates integrating data from IoT and AI devices in health care to improve patient outcomes. Many Internet of Things (IoT) devices, such as smart tech and remote tracking systems, constantly collect health data. A rigorous cleaning framework ensures data quality. This framework reduces noise and boosts signals. We use standardization, outlier reduction, and feature extraction to create a solid training model collection. Change hyperparameters and use cross-validation to improve model training and ensure accurate predictions without overtraining the model. We measure model success by accuracy, precision, and memory. A continuous feedback process, based on success data and user participation, improves third-level estimations. The findings reveal that the recommended IoT -AI method measures performance better than conventional health care systems and AI -enhanced diagnostic systems. This systematic, data-driven approach may help healthcare personnel make better choices, enhance patient outcomes, and streamline and customize the healthcare delivery system. Technology is crucial for adjusting to patient care demands in today's health care system, as shown by this research.

articleTitle: Identifying Sybil Attacks in Blockchain Networks through Behavioral Analysis and Zero Knowledge Proof implementations
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Blockchain technology is significant because it makes data sharing between several parties safe, transparent, and effective. Multi-step transactions that require verification and traceability can benefit from Blockchain technology. However, the Blockchain technology too comes with its own vulnerabilities and often Blockchain networks are attacked by attacks like 51% Attack, Eclipse Attack, Sybil Attack, Time jacking Attack, Selfish Mining Attack, Finney Attack, Race Attack and so on. One among those attacks is the Sybil attacks, which are a big threat to the integrity of Blockchain networks since they assist malicious actors to create several identities, potentially overwhelming the system and defeating the very principle of consensus mechanisms. In this paper, we have captured an approach on designing a multi-layered mechanism for identifying Sybil attacks with the integration of behavioral analysis, Blockchain analysis techniques, Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs), and a robust security architecture for governance and validator selection. The broad idea is to cancel pseudo-anonymity in the Blockchain systems by detecting behavioral patterns, identifying exchange wallets, and mapping inter-wallet relationships. Integration of these approaches with ZKPs assists in improving identity verification while simultaneously maintaining user anonymity. The proposed architecture for security uses community-based governance and adaptive validator selection processes to strengthen the defense against Sybil attacks. Token concentration analysis traces down the distribution of stakes within the network in order to find potential risks due to centralization. Our findings thus conclude that integration of the security framework along with behavior analysis and ZKPs effectively reduces the proliferation of fraudulent identities in the Blockchain networks.

articleTitle: Evaluating and Improving Message Response Time in Internet of Things (IoT) Communication Protocols: A Comprehensive Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) relies on various communication protocols to enable efficient data exchange among devices, sensors, and applications. One such widely used protocol is MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport), which operates on a publish/subscribe model, providing a lightweight and scalable solution for IoT communication. This study explores the performance of IoT systems using MQTT, focusing on key factors such as network buffering, broker memory, and Quality of Service (QoS) levels that influence message response times. The study employs Stochastic Petri Nets (SPN) to model the MQTT-based publish/subscribe system, capturing system dynamics and predicting response times under varying conditions. By optimising these factors, the study demonstrates how to reduce response times and improve system performance. Experimental results highlight the significant impact of network buffering, broker memory, and QoS levels on the overall efficiency of the IoT system. Network buffering and broker memory increase response times, while adjusting QoS levels can either improve or degrade performance based on application needs. This research provides valuable insights into optimising IoT communication, enhancing the reliability and efficiency of MQTT-based systems.

articleTitle: White Blood Cell Classification using Vision Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Deep learning techniques present significant potential for automatic classification of white blood cells (WBC) in blood smear images, which are very well assisted to get better medical diagnostic solutions. However, the distribution of different types of WBCs is often imbalanced, leading to bias in model training and difficulties in generalizing, and along with this, some WBC types have similar morphological features, making it challenging for the model to accurately distinguish between them. To address these challenges, we proposed a ViTB/32-based transformer model because transformer models are resource-intensive and works parallelly to execute inputs. therefore, the diagnostic model's accuracy of clinical features enhances effectively and improves the computational complexity. This study compares our proposed model with other leading SOTA transfer learning models like ResNet50V2, EfficientNetB7, DenseNet201, and InceptionV3, comparing based on performance metrics, revealing their strengths and limitations for WBC classification. The Vision Transformer model (ViT-B/32) outperforms other transfer learning-based models in terms of accuracy (96.06%), recall (93.2%), precision (89.6%), and F1-score (91.5%), indicating its superior ability to classify WBC images correctly.

articleTitle: Reinforcing Kubernetes Security: A Gap Analysis and Modern Security Practices for Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: In today's Cloud and DevOps landscape, Kubernetes is a cornerstone technology widely adopted by startup to enterprises and government agencies across the industries. As Kubernetes continues to evolve, so do the methods used by attackers to exploit its vulnerabilities, making robust security practices essential. This paper conducts a gap analysis of a previously published study on Kubernetes security practices, identifying areas where existing guidelines fall short in addressing emerging threats and challenges. Building on this analysis, I propose a new set of enterprise-level security practices designed to help IT professionals secure their Kubernetes ecosystems in both public cloud and on-premises environments. The methodology used in this paper includes a comprehensive review of the 2020 Kubernetes security dataset, followed by expert-driven analysis to identify and fill gaps in current practices.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis: Software Defined Network Frameworks for IOT Devices Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has become a vital part of our daily lives. As the number of IoT devices continues to grow, SDN with Distributed Resource Management (DRM) can efficiently manage the dynamic and diverse resource needs of the devices. This paper presents a novel solution which is referred to as the Enhanced Machine Learning (ML) based SDN framework. The proposed paper addresses the multifaceted challenges of optimizing IoM network resources through a comprehensive approach encompassing dynamic resource allocation, traffic flow optimization, QoS policy implementation, centralized network management, energy-efficient communication, and enhanced data processing DN's ability to intelligently assign channels using deep learning models prevents network congestion and improves performance, making it an ideal solution for managing the dynamic and large-scale traffic flows in IoT environments [10]. Overall, SDN's centralized control, flexibility, and advanced security mechanisms make it a pivotal technology for enhancing IoT networks.

articleTitle: Smart HVAC: Anomaly Detection and Energy Prediction Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Continuous growth in AI ML approaches has set the pace to enhance sound predictive algorithms for the air conditioning systems. Anomaly detection is such a field where additional optimizations can be achieved in order to minimize the energy consumed manyfold. The approach presented in this research work aims at presenting a new approach at building a more reliable anomaly detection model using AI models derived from clustering models with the silhouette coefficient of 0.35. The novel approach was trained on a time series dataset of indoor and outdoor environmental. Furthermore, we chose and compared the performances of two types of recurrent neural network (RNN) for energy consumption prediction after anomaly detection and elimination: parameters. Evaluated accuracies of the selected RNN models was 0.91 and 0.96 for the current study. The results demonstrate how AI can improve the effectiveness of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning or HVAC systems.

articleTitle: Beyond Demographics: Using HRMS Data and Employee Sentiment Analysis to Predict Turnover and Improve Retention
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Retention of employees is one of the significant challenges in today's competitive job market world, with the traditional method of turnover prediction relying on a large amount of data and limiting its effectiveness. This research, “Beyond Demography: Using HRMS data and employee sentiment analysis to predict turnover and improve retention,” introduces a novel approach that combined the human resource management system (HRMS) with sentiment analysis of employees to enhance retention strategies. By integrating metrics such as performance, tenure, and compensation from HRMS and sensitive data from surveys, emails, and internal communication, the research aims to build a more comprehensive model. An advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) technique is employed to extract the key features from employee feedback, revealing hidden dissatisfaction patterns, and machine learning algorithms (ML), including random forest, Gradient Boosting and SVM will analyze this combined dataset and provide more accurate detection of the turnover risk factors. This research work mainly focuses on developing advanced predictive monitoring and evaluation of the interventions through data analysis to ensure the dynamic retention approach. Ultimately, this research offers a holistic approach for predicting and preventing turnover and promoting a more productive workforce.

articleTitle: Multi-Step Instruction-Guided Editing for Neural Radiance Fields: Enhancing User Control in 3D Scene Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Multi-Step Instruction-Guided Editing is a novel approach for 3D scene editing that allows users to edit a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) iteratively by providing sequential instructions. Current methods, like single-step instruction models, struggle with maintaining 3D consistency when performing complex, multi-layered edits, often leading to inconsistencies across viewpoints. These existing approaches do not provide the capability to modify or change the preceding edits which makes it difficult to make intricate changes to a scene. In this paper, we introduce Multi-StepNeRF, a sequential pipeline that allows users to issue multiple text commands, each building upon the last while ensuring 3D consistency throughout. The pipeline allows, for example, to first add an object, then change its type, and later edit its properties. Intermediate NeRF models are saved at various steps along the pipeline to offer more flexibility and undo unwanted changes. We show that this method allows complicated transformations of large scenes with high precision and without breaking the consistency, which makes it possible to provide the user with an interface for realistic 3D environment editing.

articleTitle: Real-time Storage and Analysis of Smartwatch Lead-I ECG Signal Data for Intelligent Cardiac Care Using Advanced Cloud Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Integrating real-time monitoring systems has become essential in the quickly changing field of healthcare technology to provide prompt and thorough insights into cardiovascular health. The innovative solution for a Real-Time ECG data storage and streaming system is designed and implemented, which is examined in this research. This system attempts to completely change how we monitor and analyze electrocardiogram (ECG) data in light of the growing popularity of wearable ECG sensors and the increasing need for seamless integration of health data. This system seamlessly integrates advanced sensor technology with cloud-based storage and streaming capabilities, enabling the continuous acquisition, storage, and real-time analysis of electrocardiogram (ECG) data. The system's ability for continuous monitoring presents a unique opportunity to track and analyze heart health longitudinally. This functionality allows users to retrospectively examine their historical heart health patterns, which proves invaluable for the detection of diverse heart conditions. By enabling users to continuously monitor their health and review past heart health data, the system signifies a notable leap forward in cardiovascular health monitoring technology.

articleTitle: Strategic Human Resource Management (HRM) in the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The key focus of this paper is to extend the concept of digital technology and its strategic impacts on the management of human resources in the current corporate world. The present level of digital HRM adoption is defined through an analysis of secondary data collected from international surveys, trade magazines, and case studies, as well as research exploring its effects on important HRM processes and associated opportunities and challenges. Some of the statistical studies that clearly reveal causation include correlation, regression, ANOVA, and chi-square tests, which reveal very strong positive relationships between digital HRM adoption and such performance benchmarks as engagement, time to hire, and cost per hire. Test results based on Unilever and IBM's cases suggest that transitioning to digital HRM is not a myth and has common benefits, including effective recruitment, effective learning, and possibly cost efficiencies. The descriptive analysis in this study reflects the effects of contextual variables, revealing variations in adoption levels across sectors and firm sizes. The following relevant issues of implementation are also discussed: Data security is an important aspect of any change implementation, and this is discussed. The conclusion underscores the potential of digital HRM as revolutionary and offer valuable advice to those in the HR profession operating in a digital environment. The research moves on to utter the potential of future advancement and its impact on the process of HRM specialists, besides expressing the necessity to apply digital services to HR processes with more caution.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Wireless Sensor Networks: A Comparative Analysis of Performance Metrics and Model Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This research paper explores hybrid anomaly detection frameworks combining Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Bee Algorithm (ABC), and Genetic Algorithm (GA) using the CICIDS2017 dataset for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). It evaluates their effectiveness across diverse network conditions, focusing on anomaly detection accuracy, false positives, and computational efficiency. The study aims to advance anomaly detection methodologies in WSNs by contributing insights into bio-inspired algorithms' impact on anomaly detection. It targets the research community, industry professionals, and scholars, emphasizing the documentation of methodologies and suggesting future research on hybridization techniques, dynamic adaptation, edge computing integration, and machine learning fusion for enhanced anomaly detection in WSNs, fostering improved network security and adaptability.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Authentication for Financial Application Using Multi-Modal Behavioural Biometrics - A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: It is essential to ensure secure and easy user authentication in the domain of financial applications. Conventional techniques frequently fall short of offering strong security without sacrificing user pleasure. This research integrates fingerprint, signature, and eye movement patterns to provide a sophisticated multi-modal behavioral biometric identification system. In current systems, all three biometric modalities are infrequently integrated, especially for financial applications where security and usability are critical. The suggested solution promises to provide continuous authentication for mobile devices, improve authentication accuracy, and address issues such as template ageing. The multi-modal behavioral biometric is fused using Image-level fusion. It creates a single image map of fingerprint, signature, and eye movement patterns and matches it with the input image the system receives. In case of a perfect match the user is authenticated to use the service. A survey of 50 participants showed strong support for the multimodal approach, with 90% perceiving it as necessary and effective. By utilizing their combined capabilities and minimizing individual biometric weaknesses, the integrated system exhibits better security. This work also looks at the system's practical application and computing effectiveness on mobile devices with limited resources. This study offers a comprehensive solution for secure, effective, and user-friendly authentication in financial applications by filling in the gaps in the current research.

articleTitle: Review on AI-Driven Interactive Data Visualization and Predictive Analytics for Enhanced Decision Support in Health and Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), data visualization, and predictive analytics have revolutionized de- cision support in healthcare, particularly in population health and disease management. This paper presents a novel frame- work integrating AI-driven interactive data visualization with predictive analytics to enhance decision-making processes in real- time. The system aims to address the complexities of healthcare data by leveraging electronic health records (EHRs), wearable devices, and population health data to improve disease pre- diction, outbreak detection, and resource allocation. A mixed- methods approach is employed to evaluate the effectiveness of AI-enhanced models, with quantitative analyses assessing the predictive accuracy and qualitative insights drawn from health- care practitioners. The results show a 25 percent improvement in disease prediction accuracy and a 30 percent reduction in decision-making time. However, challenges such as data privacy, algorithmic bias, and AI adoption barriers remain. The research also underscores the importance of ethical considerations and scalability in deploying AI-driven systems in diverse healthcare settings. Ultimately, the proposed framework offers a scalable, adaptable, and ethically sound solution for improving health outcomes and decision-making in population health management.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Secure and Scalable Cloud Computing Through Blockchain-Powered Microservices
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Cloud computing has transformed the IT industry by providing on-demand and pay-as-you-go computing resources. However, security and privacy concerns are hindering its widespread adoption. To address these issues, we present new architectural design principles by which we can leverage blockchain technology to secure cloud computing systems. We enhance the tamper-proof nature of blockchains by deploying decentralised applications which run consensus-governed microservices directly on a blockchain or at least their cryptographic hashes along with corresponding service access control mechanisms. Here, we leverage the fact that (i) microservices offer encapsulation, eliminating the need for tamper-proof maintenance of their internal state while ensuring full availability through replicated tamper-proof hash values; (ii) microservice compositions accommodate necessary functionalities and suggest deployability options; and (iii) existing cloud infrastructures already facilitate microservice deployments due to the architectures major cloud vendors use underneath.

articleTitle: An Online Retail Platform's Structure and Performance Optimization with Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Slower economic development can be ascribed to a fall in the success of online commercial transactions due to insufficient network availability. This has generated several lines of investigation into potential remedies, including the use of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, the research, and optimization of e-commerce website architecture, and the unbiased inclusion of Internet economics and online website theory. This article defines blockchain technology, investigates its properties using theory and statistics, and demonstrates how it can be utilized to solve international electronic payment concerns. AI devised an intriguing website design. The technique is finally validated by modeling and simulating website resource allocation elements. Financial experts observe records, rebuild resource allocation, and optimize new ways during the simulation test. The testing led to more accurate results with 97.8 percent efficiency and the layout of the store was changed based on what was found.

articleTitle: Managing Digital Debris: Blockchain Solutions for E-Waste
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: In India, one promising systemic solution to existing challenges in the e-waste sector is paying workers with blockchain-based smart contracts. Blockchain technology can be used to create an end-to-end system for the collection, segregation, and recycling of Electronic and Electrical Equipment (EEEs) very transparently. First, the most important benefit is the transparency and traceability it brings. The blockchain serves as a permanent ledger that makes it clear to see and record every e-waste management transaction so they can avidly allocate the devices in their journey from disposal to recycling. Furthermore, smart contracts help automate compliance with e-waste management legislation and lower the non-compliance risk with contemporaneous penalties. They encode regulations directly into the software that helps to ensure appropriate means of disposal and recycling. Blockchain further facilitates stakeholder coordination and the development of streamlined workflows around shipping, compliance verification, or payment triggering. It increases cooperation and more effectiveness in the e-waste management supply chain. Still, the challenge is adopting technology at scale and how will data privacy/ security be ensured, it would have to prove value over time (scalability) but also nuances different regulatory compliance having not only opportunities for retail. The effort of developing such a solution is little, and there are some challenges as well for blockchain-based e-waste management systems in India. This revolutionary method can help transform the industry by improving transparency, efficiency and accountability.

articleTitle: Crop and Weed Segmentation Using ResNet-Unet Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The effectiveness of a ResNet-Unet (RU) architecture for semantic segmentation of soil and weeds from sorghum plants in high-resolution UAV photos is investigated. The model makes use of Unet's encoder-decoder structure for precise segmentation and ResNet's deep residual learning for efficient feature extraction. To increase the resilience of the model, data augmentation methods such random rotations, flips, and horizontal and vertical adjustments were used, along with contrast enhancement methods like Gamma Correction and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Utilizing the ResNet-Unet framework, we were able to attain a maximum SØrensen-Dice Coefficient (DS) of 0.929, accompanied by a standard deviation of 0.0041. Classification measures show impressive accuracy: among background, sorghum, and weed classes, precision, recall, and F1-score range from 93.01\% to 99.68\%. The efficiency of RU architecture for precision agriculture applications is demonstrated by this study, which also provides a viable option for targeted weed management and automated weed detection.

articleTitle: Analysis of Image Classification Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Among the technologies that are utilized in the research and development of contemporary science and technology, image classification is an essential technology. Scholars from a variety of nations have not only become proficient in the application of a significant amount of theoretical knowledge, but they have also established a solid foundation for the categorization of images and the description of their features. One of the most significant methods in the field of machine learning is known as support vector machine, and it has been utilized extensively in the process of image identification and classification. In the process of researching the application technology of image classification based on support vector machine, researchers from both the United States and other countries primarily focus on analysing the characteristics of image forms, textures, colours, and spatial relationships. In this Paper, the primary focus is on the application of support vector machine in image classification, with the purpose of evaluating its efficiency via the use of actual examples and calculate Performance mesearurment. Using the existing knowledge of image classification and support vector machine research as a foundation, it intends to make a contribution to the development of network technology research in the new era.

articleTitle: Recent Developments in Link Prediction for Drug Interaction Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Drug-drug interactions also known as DDIs are dangerous phenomena in the sphere of pharmacology and healthcare, contributing to negative side effects and problems in the treatment of patients. Predicting the likely DDIs is an important effort in drug development and application, individualized therapeutics and the overall patient care and safety. In this research, link prediction approach from network science and machine learning are applied to discover the unseen relationships between drugs. We use drugs as nodes and interactions as edges of the graph as well as use different predictive algorithms which may include similarity measures, machine learning classification, and deep learning to predict new edges between drugs that have not interacted in the past. To increase the level of prediction accuracy, we consider a wide range of characteristics that are based on chemical structures, biological pathways, and pharmacological actions. The outcome of our suggestive frame work is measure on standard data sets-which show its usefulness for predicting both known and novel drug interactions. Here, we have compared the performance of DDI predictions based on both multi-dimensional data and link prediction and it has been shown that the link prediction models enhance the reliability of the predictions. This study seems to offer a systematic way to identify potentially problematic drug-drug interactions therefore could eventually help safeguard patient from adverse effects resulting from drug prescription and potentially aid drug development process.

articleTitle: Resume Ranking with TF-IDF, Cosine Similarity and Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Resume ranking algorithms have become a vital tool in modern workforce management, as they help applicants face almost insurmountable odds of ever scoring an interview. Natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning algorithms are used to assess a candidate's resume and sort them on the basis with which he/she is compatible with the specific job description. This paper analyses many resume ranking methods with an emphasis on the Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and cosine Similarity. All these methods help us refine the ranking system for resumes and, hence, better relevant scores. In addition, Named Entity Recognition (NER) improves the possibility of detecting key entities, including skills and experience, to lead to a better ranking system. This also had the edge case where traditional ranking approaches failed to respond with limited functionality as they were limited to shallow keyword matching and provided only a summary of candidates' profiles. It addresses the problem of resume ranking competition and presents three other critical issues: bias, transparency and data privacy. Finally, it evaluates the ability of the system to detect and track against conventional methods. It also sets a path for future research in the field of business and to find out how efficient these resume screening automated systems.

articleTitle: The Role of Machine Learning Algorithms in Stock Market Prediction: A Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The stock market is where people buy and sell shares of publicly listed companies. These stock prices fluctuate up and down based on demand and supply. The other factors include weather, company news reports, changes in management, etc. People can earn a great fortune if they can find a way to predict the future prices of the stock market and accordingly make their investments. Our research aims to find the best model to predict the stock prices effectively. The models we tested include simple regression models and a stacked LSTM (Long-Short-Term Memory) model designed for accurate prediction of stock prices. The reason behind choosing a stacked LSTM model is that it enables us to process time-series data, hence enabling our model to understand the trends better. The metrics used include Mean Square Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Root Mean Square Error (RME). The final scores enable us to determine the best model that does not overfit our data, hence enabling us to maximize our profit. Furthermore, the model is tested by recording prices at an interval of 24 hours, 1 hour, and 5 minutes to find a model that gives us the best accuracy.

articleTitle: Gesture Bridge: Connecting World Through Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: A real-time sign language generator has been created using a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) deep learning approach in order to decrease the lack of interaction among the general public and the deaf and hard-of-hearing communities. Through turning conversation into gestures and sign languages motions to written content, this approach makes two-way communication easier. The LSTM model reliably translates actions into texts after being trained on an extensive dataset of sign language visuals. Furthermore, oral input gets converted to text utilizing an NLP-powered speech analysis module, that subsequently converts it into gesture motions. A translator, that is integrated into an interactive web-based application, facilitates successful, immediate interaction through a microphone for voice and a webcam for gestures, encouraging accessibility and inclusion for all users.

articleTitle: Development of Efficient Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Prediction of Leaf Disease Identification in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Agriculture is the real backbone of an economic growth, plays a critical part in any country's economic growth and development. In many cases, agriculture production may be reduced, thereby reducing the nation's economy, because crops may be harmed by diseases. Diseases generally affect the leaves of the crop and should be identified early on so that the quality and quantity of the produce can be increased. The Deep convolutional neural network model is being implemented on a Kaggle benchmark dataset of tomato plant leaves. Gamma correction, images flipping, noise injection, scaling, color augmentation, & rotation were the five data augmentation methods used. Our experiments with two datasets, augmented and non-augmented, and found that data augmentation can improve model performance. The proposed model's training contains batch size, training epochs and dropouts. When using validation data, the suggested model outperforms other common learning algorithms. After extensive simulation, the proposed model has achieved 97.49% classification performance. The precision of the suggested task exceeds that of typical machine learning methodologies. Consistency and dependability are also examined for the suggested model.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enhanced AI Security and Trust Through Auditable Decision-Making and Data Integrity in Modern Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: AI and blockchain can make companies safer and more trustworthy. AI can handle massive quantities of data and make complicated judgments, but its lack of clarity and reliance on centralized data present safety, accountability, and openness concerns. Blockchain ensures data is accurate, clear, and simple to track with its decentralized and unchangeable record. Blockchain can improve AI systems by making decision-making more open and safer for AI data. Blockchain protects AI model data from unauthorized changes. This prevents illicit alterations and improves AI accuracy. Blockchain's autonomy lets parties independently verify AI decision-making, which fosters confidence. This study examines blockchain's primary AI protections. These include open data storage, validated AI models, and trustworthy smart contracts that make decisions automatically. Real-world examples from healthcare, finance, and supply chain management show how blockchain-enhanced AI could address data breaches, algorithmic bias, and machine accountability. These findings demonstrate that adding blockchain to AI systems increases their trustworthiness and makes AI use in modern organizations safer and more open.

articleTitle: Brain MRI Analysis Using CNN-Based Feature Extraction and Machine Learning Techniques to Diagnose Alzheimer's Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This research focuses on developing a complex framework for automatic diagnosis purposes of Alzheimer's disease from MRI brain data, with emphasis placed on advancement in accuracy towards early detection, using CNN-based feature extraction and machine learning classifiers. The models were trained, validated, and tested on two public accessible datasets: ADNI and MIRIAD. Prior to scaling the MRI images for the ResNet-50 architecture, preprocessing methods such as noise reduction and skull stripping were applied. The paper has analyzed the data gathered using three classifiers: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and SoftMax. The experimental result finds ResNet50-Softmax outperforming other classifiers. Its accuracy was at level 98% along with specificity at 99%, sensitivity at 98%, and F-measure at 99% on the ADNI dataset. Other impressive performances were witnessed on MIRIAD dataset with accuracy 98%, specificity 97%, sensitivity 99% and 98% F-measure. These results, combined with ResNet-50, prove the resilience of the SoftMax classifier for accurate AD classification. Overall findings in this study show that the proposed CNN-based method can serve as a viable avenue to automatically and accurately diagnose Alzheimer's, thus aiding its treatment and early intervention.

articleTitle: Creative AI Approaches to Biomedical Imaging: Revolutionizing Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence in biomedical imaging has now set a new trend in diagnosis. This has been made possible to allow accuracy, speed, and even possible adaptability as has not been seen within this field. This paper presents new approaches to AI-driven techniques and applications, deep learning, machine learning, and artists' algorithms to further improve the accuracy of medical imaging. Other diagnostic methods are effective yet they carry issues like high error rates, duration taken before one's findings are complete or identification of intricate or uncommon diseases. We review the present applications of AI in identifying opportunities and challenges for integrating AI into clinical practice: good data sets, proper utilization, and the like.

articleTitle: Addressing Security Challenges in Artificial Intelligence Driven Clinical Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: This research aims to develop a novel security architecture to overcome complex security concerns in AI-powered hospitals and protect sensitive healthcare data. Symmetric key encryption, decoding, and enhanced post-processing ensure data privacy, security, and dependability. The framework employs key management for secure encryption. It also detects errors to ensure data accuracy. We compared the framework's performance to existing security approaches using data encryption standards, access control mechanisms, user identification, and anomaly detection accuracy. The comparison shows that the proposed technique outperforms the others in all categories. It outperforms conventional approaches in system stability, event response time, and healthcare regulatory compliance. The framework's stringent post-processing processes provide consistent decryption and validation. It provides an additional layer of protection against unauthorized access, data breaches, and alterations. Combining encryption and post-processing into one structure enhances healthcare data safety and management. This new system exceeds security norms. Healthcare organizations can securely employ AI-powered technologies while adhering to security protocols.

articleTitle: Hybrid Encryption for Privacy Preservation in Medical Image Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: As the use of telemedicine and e-health rises, it has become essential to transfer medical images securely. Access to such sensitive images can result to serious privacy violations; transmission attacks are also destructive to data integrity. In this paper, we present a new encryption method that integrates the usage of chaotic maps and the advanced encryption standard (AES) in order to enhance the security of the signals during transmission. The algorithm adopted is secured against different types of cryptographic attacks such as brute force attack, chosen plaintext attack and differential attack. Performance analysis of the proposed method is done using entropy, correlation coefficient, key sensitivity and execution time and then compared with other encryption algorithms. The simulation results given in the paper clearly point to the effectiveness and security of the proposed algorithm that can be recommended for the implementation of medical image transmission in e-health applications.

articleTitle: Learning Efficacy Augmentation for Bose—Einstein Condensates of Numerical Representations: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: New augmentation and synthesis techniques will boldly lead into a revolution in this work as one looks forward to the future of Bose-Einstein Condensate research. It is during this conference that I shall discuss whether advanced methodologies, such as GANs and VAEs, can find untold depths in the complexity of BEC data analysis and interpretation. These methods counter critical bottlenecks of scarcity of data and quantum states complexity by generating highly realistic synthetic data that captures precisely all the intricacies of the BEC. This, therefore, enables the precision in simulations and analyses that opens a window into phenomena that are very rare to occur and could only never be observed without the new technologies. Papers in these areas show that these technologies make models more robust and enhance predictive accuracy and accelerate progress in experimental approaches. By embracing these state-of-the-art methodologies, research by BEC is now ready for a much bigger transformation in the very approach and way of carrying out its current undertaking. Alone, it shall be a major breakthrough for the understanding of quantum systems and consequently paving new horizons for quantum science; profound insight into the complex system.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Recognising Alzheimer Disease Using GA Enabled GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a chronic neurodegenerative disease, where early stages of detection play a crucial role in improving patient treatment. However, patients with Fronto Temporal Dementia (FTD) are often misdiagnosed with Alzheimer's disease due to limitations in diagnosis algorithms. While various machine learning and deep learning techniques have been applied to classify the stages of Alzheimer's disease, accurate early-stage diagnosis remains challenging which would give a better explanation of its variations with FTD. Though many theories have been developed to diagnose it, Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) has proven to be a powerful tool in observing detailed patient images. Several machine learning models have been exploited by researchers to diagnose Alzheimer's disease. Though many techniques have been applied to the diagnosis and classification of Alzheimer's disease, there is a need for more accuracy in early diagnosis solutions. In this study, the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) dataset is used to predict the disease diagnosis using the Genetic Algorithm (GA). The results of GAGAN (Genetic Algorithm based Generative Adversarial Network) model is compared to traditional GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) to evaluate performance, with a specific focus on improved classification accuracy and sensitivity. Results demonstrate that GA optimization enhances GAN's diagnostic accuracy, offering a more robust framework for real-world application in early AD detection, which can contribute to better patient care and quality of life.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Indian Stock Market Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The financial stock market is unpredictable and nonlinear, making forecasting it difficult. A number of factors, including traders' irrational and reasonable actions as well as their psychological and emotional states, contribute to the stock market's growing volatility. Deep learning and AI-based algorithms have changed the financial stock market's movement prediction in recent years after receiving their education. Traders are using these Machine Learning (ML) approaches to help them make decisions on stock values. A model predicting the future direction of the Indian stock market's movement has been made available to the public. This model integrates historical Indian stock data from companies that have been part of the Nifty 50 from its establishment with a range of financial and social elements, such as stock-related comments and economic news items. In an attempt to improve accuracy and reduce RMSE error, this sequence of data is pre-processed, normalized, and then subjected to a diversity of machine learning (ML) techniques, including gradient boosting regression, long short-term memory (LSTM), support vector machine (SVM), K-nearest neighbor (KNN), and random forest. We are also applying a range of machine learning approaches and fine-tuning the LSTM in novel ways to improve accuracy. We are also computing metrics such as MAE and MSE. Those who invest in equities may use this tactic to halt large losses. Forecasts for the investing sector will become clearer thanks to the social indices. Tweets, trade volume, and previous closing prices will all be utilized by the LSTM network.

articleTitle: Combining 3D Convolutional Neural Networks with Recurrent Neural Networks to Improve the Accuracy of Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer Detection Using Multiparametric MRI Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: Prostatic adenocarcinoma is ranked amongst the most widespread cancers which rank high in the list of cancer deaths in the world. Advanced imaging techniques in medicine such as multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging have improved the chances of identifying the prostatic adenocarcinoma. This has been achieved in the context of deep learning successfully applied to medical images by constructing an automated image analysis system, which consists of RNN and 3D convolutional neural networks to detect clinically significant PCa in the entire volume of mpMRI images. This paper contributes to this line of work by proposing a two-stage pipeline where 3DCNN is used in the first stage for the extraction of features from volumetric images and an RNN in the second stage for slice interdependency modelling. For our two-class dataset, 500 patients are included, out of them, 200 patients have clinically significant PCa and 300 patients are without PCa. A test set of 100 patients not used in training was employed to further validate the model. At the slice level, the pipeline achieved an AUC of 0.89 with a 95% confidence interval of 0.86-0.92 while at the patient level, the pipeline performed with an AUC of 0.86 and 95% confidence interval of 0.81-0.91. This study has brought forth evidence that prostate cancer detection using 3DCNN-RNN hybridized model is clinically feasible.

articleTitle: Virtual Library: A Guide to Digital Resources for Education using Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)
abstract: The integration of Virtual Reality (VR) technologies within educational settings is revolutionizing access to learning resources, offering a more immersive and engaging experience. A Virtual Library powered by the metaverse creates dynamic, interactive environments where students and educators can explore and learn together. By utilizing the Meta All-in-One SDK, the library supports advanced VR interactions, allowing users to navigate virtual spaces and interact with digital content seamlessly using VR headsets like the Meta Quest.
